title: Senior Operations Manager (Client Success & Systems) $2,500 p/m + Bonuses
description:
Full-Time | Long-Term Leadership Role



Salary: Start at $2,000 per month during the first 2-month trial period. After successful completion, move to $2,500 per month plus performance-based bonuses.



Payment: Twice a month via Wise. Always on time.



Can you look at a team's daily metrics, spot an operational gap, and build the exact system needed to fix it?



Our company has served over 3,600+ clients, and we are scaling fast.



We are hunting for a data-driven, highly organized Systems & Client Operations Manager to take full ownership of our Airtable CRMs, audit team workflows, and lead our Customer Success team to maximum efficiency.



If you are a self-starter who loves building dashboards, auditing performance, and driving retention without being micromanaged, this leadership role is for you. Apply today!



ABOUT US



Young Publisher – 



We have proudly served over 3,600+ clients since 2020, and we are just getting started. Young Publisher is an international digital marketing company running a high-growth monetization system for content creators and online brands. We provide an 80% done-for-you content and monetization system that helps beginners and early-stage creators go viral and turn views into income using short-form content, AI tools, and proven strategies. We focus on structure, accountability, and long-term team growth.



BENEFITS



- Full-time stable income

- Monday to Friday schedule

- Flexible working hours

- Payments: twice a month via Wise

- Performance-based bonuses

- Clear salary progression after trial

- Real ownership and leadership responsibility

- Direct collaboration with senior leadership

- Clear path to senior leadership or director level

- Access to paid AI tools and systems

- High-growth environment

- Strong company culture



TASKS



- Lead and manage CSMs, onboarding managers, and content support roles

- Monitor daily reports and team performance

- Audit onboarding calls, client calls, DMs, and check-ins

- Run weekly team training and review calls

- Identify underperformers early and take action

- Oversee CRM health in Airtable

- Improve reporting systems and dashboards

- Align Customer Success with Sales and leadership

- Improve onboarding, escalation, churn rescue, and upsell SOPs

- Fix operational gaps and build scalable systems

- Help interview and train new tea
mbers

- Proactively identify at-risk clients

- Oversee refund and dispute handling

- Solve root causes behind churn



This is a leadership role. You are trusted to own outcomes, not be micromanaged on tasks.

If you prefer a task-only execution role, this is not for you.



REQUIREMENTS



- 2+ years of experience in customer success operations, community management, or similar

- Experience managing or coordinating 10–20 tea
mbers

- Strong Airtable, Slack, and Google Workspace experience

- Experience building SOPs, dashboards, and reporting systems

- Excellent written and spoken English

- Self-starter mentality

- Comfortable working across multiple time zones



NICE TO HAVE EXPERIENCE



- Restructuring customer success teams

- High-ticket coaching or online education

- Knowledge of churn analysis and lifecycle metrics

- Working in a CS agency

Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

title: Technical Onboarding Manager (Customer Success & Tech Support) - $900 p/m + Bonuses
description:
JOB OVERVIEW



We are hiring a Technical Onboarding Manager (TOM).



Your job is to guide new clients through their first 48 hours inside the program. You remove confusion, fix tech issues, assign the right 1:1 Coach, and make sure clients are fully set up before strategy begins.



This is not a passive support role. You are responsible for structure, clarity, activation speed, and client confidence.



This is a client-facing role. You must be clear, confident, calm, and reliable.



Most of our clients are 45+ and not tech-savvy. Patience and strong communication are required.



BENEFITS



- Salary: $900 per month

- Payment: Twice a month via Wise. Always on time.

- Performance bonuses based on CSAT (client rating) and CSQ (coach rating)

- OTE: $1,050–$1,400/month

- Bonus tiers from $30–$100 per category (minimum 20 surveys / 20 handoffs per month)

- Fully remote, long-term role

- Clear scorecard and monthly reviews

- Career growth path (Senior TOM, Lead TOM, CSM)

- 4,000+ clients served since 2019



SCHEDULE



- 7.5 hours per day (Monday to Friday)

- No fixed shift required. You may work a straight or split shift.

- You must attend tea
etings (usually 3pm CET)

- Work 7.5 total hours per day within the 8 AM ET to 2 AM ET coverage window, not across the entire window

- Confirm your preferred working hours during hiring

- Maintain a schedule that is sustainable long term



Consistently low energy or repeated mistakes caused by poor schedule management will be treated as performance issues.



RESPONSIBILITIES



- Run structured Activation Calls

- Fully activate every client within 48 hours. Activation means the client has access to Kajabi, Slack, the Client Master Sheet, AI tools (AVA & VERA), understands where everything is, has a Coach assigned, and has their Kickoff Call booked.

- Book Kickoff Call same day or next day

- Assign the correct 1:1 Coach based on phase, fluency, timezone, and availability

- Build authority for the assigned Coach so the client feels confident before strategy begins

- Ensure basic access or setup issues do not reach Coaches

- Update CRM immediately after each call

- Send clear handoff notes to Coaches

- Upload all call recordings

- Reply in #tech-support within 24 hours (weekdays)

- Onboard 20–25 clients per week. Activation Calls are structured and typically 30–45 minutes.

Some weeks are high-volume during promotions. Quality and clarity must remain strong under pressure.

- Keep your calendar accurate and available

- Proactively manage your calendar capacity and flag issues early

- Avoid repeated client-facing process errors



Main goal: Zero confusion for the client. No surprises for the Coach.



CORE STANDARDS



- 100% activation within 48 hours

- CSAT average 85%+

- No Kickoff Call no-shows

- Prevent basic technical escalations

- High CRM accuracy and immediate handoffs

- 24-hour Slack response time

- Reliable, consistent performance



REQUIREMENTS



- Strong customer support or onboarding experience

- C1 English or higher

- Calm with older or low-tech clients

- Comfortable repeating instructions clearly multiple times

- Follows SOPs and scripts closely

- Advanced Slack skills

- Comfortable with Kajabi, Google Drive, and Zoom

- Willing to learn basic creator tools

- Reliable internet, strong camera, proper lighting, and quiet workspace

- Strong schedule discipline



WE ARE NOT A FIT IF



- You are low energy or unclear

- You get frustrated with confused clients

- You cannot explain tech in simple words

- You struggle to follow structured processes

- You cannot consistently maintain agreed working hours

- You have poor camera, lighting, or internet setup



HOW TO APPLY



Fill in the form: 
/to/nI8lIXV4



In the Name field write: “TOM” + Your First and Last Name



Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.



P.S. Once hired, you will be contracted under Social Influence Consulting LLC.

title: B2B Cold Caller / Appointment Setter — US Medical Equipment Company (Night Shift, US Pacific Hours)
description:
Brewer Medical Solutions is a US company that calibrates and repairs hearing-testing equipment for medical clinics. We are hiring 5–10 experienced cold callers to phone audiology clinics, ENT offices, pediatric clinics, and school districts across California, Nevada, and Arizona.



These are business-to-business calls to office staff during US business hours. No consumer calling, no selling pressure tactics. Your job on each call:





Reach the office manager or decision-maker

Find out when their testing equipment is next due for calibration

Record the decision-maker's name and
 accurately

Book an appointment or callback when there is interest





You will work inside Close CRM (we provide the account and full training). Every call is logged and recorded. Accurate data entry is as important as your phone skills — a call where you capture the calibration due date and contact details correctly is a successful call even if they don't book today.



Schedule

US Pacific business hours: 8:30 AM – 4:30 PM Pacific, Monday–Friday

This is approximately 11:30 PM – 7:30 AM Manila time (night shift)

Do not apply if you cannot reliably work these hours





Requirements

Excellent spoken English with a clear, neutral accent

At least 1 year of US B2B cold calling or appointment setting experience

Quiet home workspace (no background noise, no traffic)

Wired fiber internet, 25 Mbps or faster, with a backup connection (pocket wifi or second ISP)

Noise-canceling USB headset

Comfortable using a CRM (Close experience is a plus but not required)

Accurate, careful data entry — we check





How to apply (read carefully — applications that skip these steps are deleted)





Start your application with the word CALIBRATE so we know you read this posting

Include a link to a voice recording (
 is fine, 60–90 seconds) where you: introduce yourself, describe your cold calling experience, and read this script line naturally: "Hi, this is [your name] calling from Brewer Medical Solutions on a recorded line. We service audiometric equipment — could you tell me who handles your equipment calibration?"

Include a screenshot of a speedtest.net result from your home connection

Tell us your cold calling experience: what industry, what volume of dials per day, and what dialer/CRM you used



Shortlisted applicants will do a paid live test call with the owner before hiring.

description:

We are hiring a Technical Onboarding Manager (TOM).



Your job is to guide new clients through their first 48 hours inside the program. You remove confusion, fix tech issues, assign the right 1:1 Coach, and make sure clients are fully set up before strategy begins.



This is not a passive support role. You are responsible for structure, clarity, activation speed, and client confidence.

- Salary: $900 per month

- Performance bonuses based on CSAT (client rating) and CSQ (coach rating)

- OTE: $1,050–$1,400/month

- Bonus tiers from $30–$100 per category (minimum 20 surveys / 20 handoffs per month)

- Fully remote, long-term role

- Clear scorecard and monthly reviews

- Career growth path (Senior TOM, Lead TOM, CSM)

- 4,000+ clients served since 2019



SCHEDULE



- 7.5 hours per day (Monday to Friday)

- No fixed shift required. You may work a straight or split shift.

- You must attend tea
etings (usually 3pm CET)

- Work 7.5 total hours per day within the 8 AM ET to 2 AM ET coverage window, not across the entire window

- Confirm your preferred working hours during hiring

- Maintain a schedule that is sustainable long term



Consistently low energy or repeated mistakes caused by poor schedule management will be treated as performance issues.



RESPONSIBILITIES



- Run structured Activation Calls

- Fully activate every client within 48 hours. Activation means the client has access to Kajabi, Slack, the Client Master Sheet, AI tools (AVA & VERA), understands where everything is, has a Coach assigned, and has their Kickoff Call booked.

- Book Kickoff Call same day or next day

- Assign the correct 1:1 Coach based on phase, fluency, timezone, and availability

- Build authority for the assigned Coach so the client feels confident before strategy begins

- Ensure basic access or setup issues do not reach Coaches

- Update CRM immediately after each call

- Send clear handoff notes to Coaches

- Upload all call recordings

- Reply in #tech-support within 24 hours (weekdays)

- Onboard 20–25 clients per week. Activation Calls are structured and typically 30–45 minutes.

Some weeks are high-volume during promotions. Quality and clarity must remain strong under pressure.

- Keep your calendar accurate and available

- Proactively manage your calendar capacity and flag issues early

- Avoid repeated client-facing process errors



Main goal: Zero confusion for the client. No surprises for the Coach.



CORE STANDARDS



- 100% activation within 48 hours

- CSAT average 85%+

- No Kickoff Call no-shows

- Prevent basic technical escalations

- High CRM accuracy and immediate handoffs

- 24-hour Slack response time

- Reliable, consistent performance



REQUIREMENTS



- Strong customer support or onboarding experience

- C1 English or higher

- Calm with older or low-tech clients

- Comfortable repeating instructions clearly multiple times

- Follows SOPs and scripts closely

- Advanced Slack skills

- Comfortable with Kajabi, Google Drive, and Zoom

- Willing to learn basic creator tools

- Reliable internet, strong camera, proper lighting, and quiet workspace

- Strong schedule discipline



WE ARE NOT A FIT IF



- You are low energy or unclear

- You cannot explain tech in simple words

- You struggle to follow structured processes

- You cannot consistently maintain agreed working hours

- You have poor camera, lighting, or internet setup

title: Detail-Oriented Instagram Outreach Virtual Assistant | Part-Time, Long-Term
description:
Detail-Oriented Instagram Outreach Virtual Assistant — Part-Time With Full-Time Growth



Starting rate: $5 USD per hour

Starting schedule: 8:00 a.m. to 12:00 p.m. U.S. Central Time

Hours: 4 hours per day, Monday through Friday

Starting workload: Approximately 20 hours per week

Growth opportunity: Potential expansion to 8 hours per day and increased pay

Company: Beholden Visuals

Industry: Real estate photography, video, and marketing

Location: Fully remote



Please Read the Entire Job Posting Before Applying



Beholden Visuals is a growing real estate media company serving real estate agents and other real estate professionals in the Houston, Texas area.



We are hiring a dependable and highly attentive Instagram Outreach Virtual Assistant to help us build relationships with real estate professionals through organized, manual Instagram engagement.



This position will begin at four hours per day, Monday through Friday, from:



8:00 a.m. to 12:00 p.m. U.S. Central Time — Houston time



You must be available and actively working throughout this four-hour shift.



The starting rate is $5 USD per hour.



As you demonstrate accuracy, reliability, strong communication, and the ability to manage additional responsibilities, we intend to expand the position gradually toward eight hours per day.



Exceptional performance may also lead to a pay increase after a performance discussion. We are looking for someone who can grow with the company and take on more responsibility over time.



This is not a position for someone who rushes through tasks, multitasks during training, or guesses when instructions are unclear.



We need someone who:



- Pays close attention during training and Zoo
etings

- Follows written instructions carefully

- Notices small details before they become mistakes

- Communicates immediately when something is unclear

- Accurately documents every completed action

- Can consistently perform repetitive tasks without losing focus

- Is comfortable receiving feedback

- Wants a stable, long-term opportunity

- Is interested in eventually growing into a full-time position



You do not need to be an advanced social media strategist. Reliability, judgment, communication, and attention to detail are more important than having an impressive title.



What You Will Be Doing



You will receive a daily queue of Instagram outreach tasks through our CRM.



Your responsibilities may include:



- Opening assigned real estate agents’ Instagram profiles

- Confirming that you have located the correct person and account

- Following accounts when instructed

- Liking appropriate recent posts

- Leaving relevant and natural comments using our guidelines

- Viewing and engaging with Instagram Stories

- Sending approved initial direct messages

- Completing scheduled follow-up messages and inbox bumps

- Accurately recording completed actions in our CRM

- Flagging inactive, fake, incorrect, or questionable accounts

- Checking for possible duplicate outreach

- Avoiding current clients and people already contacted by another company account

- Following daily activity limits and account-safety procedures

- Providing a short end-of-shift update

- Completing additional administrative or lead-management tasks as the position grows



All Instagram activity must be completed manually.



We do not use bots, mass-messaging software, or unauthorized Instagram automation.



You will receive training and written procedures. However, you must be willing to think carefully, ask questions, and avoid making assumptions.



Example of the Judgment We Expect



The CRM may instruct you to contact an Instagram account, but you might notice that:



- The person may already be a client

- Another Beholden Visuals account may have already contacted them

- The Instagram handle may be incorrect

- The account may no longer belong to a real estate professional

- The person may not be located in our service area

- The appropriate post to engage with may not be obvious



In these situations, you should stop, document what you found, and ask for clarification instead of guessing.



We would rather answer a question than correct an avoidable mistake.



Required Qualifications



You must have:



- Strong written and spoken English

- Excellent attention to detail

- Reliable high-speed internet

- Backup internet access or a clear backup plan

- A reliable smartphone capable of running the current Instagram app

- A dependable computer or laptop

- A functioning webcam and microphone for Zoo
etings

- The ability to follow a documented process

- The ability to work independently without constant supervision

- Consistent weekday availability

- Comfort using a CRM or learning a new CRM

- A quiet environment for meetings and training

- The ability to receive feedback professionally

- The willingness to ask questions when instructions are unclear

- An interest in eventually growing into an eight-hour-per-day position



Previous experience with Instagram outreach, lead generation, data entry, CRM systems, real estate, or virtual assistance is helpful but not required.



Exceptional entry-level candidates who demonstrate strong judgment and attention to detail will still be considered.



This Position Is Not a Good Fit for You If



Please do not apply if you:



- Cannot consistently work from 8:00 a.m. to 12:00 p.m. U.S. Central Time

- Regularly multitask during meetings or training

- Have difficulty remaining attentive during Zoom calls

- Prefer to guess instead of asking questions

- Frequently overlook written instructions

- Submit generic applications without reading the complete posting

- Dislike repetitive and process-based work

- Plan to use bots or automated Instagram engagement tools

- Are already committed to another job during the same working hours

- Cannot attend required training or check-in meetings

- Frequently lose internet access without a backup plan

- Are not interested in taking on additional responsibilities over time



Starting Schedule



The position will begin with the following schedule:



Monday through Friday

8:00 a.m. to 12:00 p.m. U.S. Central Time

Four hours per day

Approximately 20 hours per week



This schedule follows Houston, Texas time throughout the year.



You must be fully available during the entire shift. You may not simultaneously work for another employer or client during these scheduled hours.



You must also be fully present during meetings and training. You may not complete unrelated work, communicate with other clients, or multitask during company meetings.



Opportunity to Grow to Full-Time



Our goal is to find someone who can grow with Beholden Visuals.



The position will begin at four hours per day. Depending on your performance and the needs of the company, your schedule may be expanded gradually toward eight hours per day.



Additional responsibilities may include:



- Managing larger daily outreach queues

- Completing follow-up communication

- Reviewing and organizing lead information

- Verifying Instagram accounts

- Maintaining CRM records

- Identifying duplicate or incorrect leads

- Assisting with lead research

- Helping document company processes

- Completing other administrative and marketing-support tasks



Additional hours are not guaranteed immediately. They will be based on available work, accuracy, reliability, communication, and your ability to successfully manage your current responsibilities.



Compensation and Performance Reviews



The starting rate is:



$5 USD per hour



At approximately 20 hours per week, this will generally equal around $100 USD per week, depending on the exact number of hours worked.



The selected candidate will begin with a paid trial period. Payments will be made weekly during the trial.



After successfully completing the trial, the regular payment schedule may move to twice per month.



Candidates who consistently demonstrate strong performance may be considered for a pay increase after a discussion and performance review.



Pay increases may happen relatively quickly for an exceptional candidate, but increases will be based on demonstrated performance and must be discussed and approved.



Performance will be evaluated based on:



- Accuracy

- Attention to detail

- Reliability

- Communication

- Ability to follow instructions

- Quality of CRM documentation

- Ability to learn from feedback

- Consistency

- Judgment

- Ability to take on additional responsibilities



How to Apply



Follow every instruction below.



Applications that are missing required items or do not follow the requested format will not move forward.



Use exactly 8 Apply Points when submitting your application.



Begin the first line of your OnlineJobs.ph application with:



DETAILS MATTER



Then provide the following items in this exact order.



1. Written Introduction



In five sentences or fewer, explain:



- Your relevant work experience

- Why this particular position interests you

- Why you believe you are dependable

- Your current employment situation

- Whether you currently work for any other clients



Please be honest about your existing workload and availability.



2. Resume



Provide a link to your current resume in PDF format.



Make sure the link is accessible to anyone with the link. We should not have to request permission to open it.



3. Internet-Speed Test

Also include:

You may use Speedtest by Ookla, 
, or another recognized internet-speed testing service.



4. Equipment Information



Tell us:



- Your computer or laptop model

- Your operating system

- Your smartphone model

- Whether you have a functioning webcam

- Whether you have a functioning headset or microphone

- Whether you have backup equipment

- Whether you have a backup power source or plan for power interruptions



5. Two-Minute Video



Record a video of yourself answering the questions below.



Your video should be approximately two minutes and must not exceed three minutes.



The video does not need to be professionally edited. You may record it using Loom, your phone, your webcam, Google Drive, or an unlisted YouTube video.



Please speak naturally. Do not simply read answers written by artificial intelligence or another person.



Answer all five questions:

3. Imagine that the CRM tells you to message an Instagram account, but you notice that the person may already be a client or may have been contacted by another company account. What would you do?



4. Tell us about a real situation in which you caught a small mistake or important detail before it became a larger problem.



5. This position begins at four hours per day but may eventually grow to eight hours per day. Why are you interested in growing with a company long-term?

 the video link to:

 subject line:



Instagram VA Video — Your Full Name



In the body of the
, include:



- Your full name

- Your OnlineJobs.ph profile link

- Your video link

- Confirmation that you are available Monday through Friday from 8:00 a.m. to 12:00 p.m. U.S. Central Time



In your OnlineJobs.ph application, write:



My video has been
ed.



Do not attach a large video file directly to the
. Send a viewable link.



6. Availability

7. Final Attention Check

I will ask instead of guessing.



What Happens After You Apply



Applications will be reviewed based on:



- Whether every application instruction was followed

- Whether the video was sent to the correct
 address

- Communication ability

- Attention and engagement during the application video

- Judgment in the scenario questions

- Internet and equipment reliability

Shortlisted applicants may be invited to complete a brief paid skills assessment.



The strongest candidates will then be invited to a Zoom interview.



During the Zoom interview, candidates must have their cameras turned on, be in a quiet environment, and remain fully attentive throughout the conversation.



We are looking for someone who wants a stable opportunity, takes pride in careful work, and is interested in growing from a part-time position into a larger long-term role.



We look forward to reviewing your application.

Many of our clients are going through one of the most difficult periods of their lives. Every conversation matters, which is why we're looking for someone who is professional, empathetic and genuinely enjoys helping people.

We believe in building long-term relationships with our tea
mbers by providing ongoing support, training and opportunities for growth.



What You'll Be Doing

- Building trust and making clients feel comfortable.

- Asking questions to understand their circumstances.

- Explaining our process clearly and professionally.

- Recording accurate notes in our CRM.

- Scheduling and completing follow-up calls.

- Sending client intake documentation when required.

- Working closely with our legal and administration teams.

- Submitting a daily end-of-day report.



Who Will Succeed In This Role?

- Enjoys speaking with people.

- Communicates confidently in fluent English.

- Can build rapport quickly.

- Listens carefully before responding.

- Is organised and detail-oriented.

- Follows systems and processes consistently.

- Learns new software quickly.

- Takes ownership of your work.

- Can work independently while remaining part of a team.

- Customer Service

- Client Support

- Appointment Setting

- Warm Lead Calling

- Virtual Assistance

- Insurance

- Medical Administration

- Legal Administration

Minimum Requirements

- Excellent spoken and written English.

- A reliable computer.

- High-speed internet.

- A quiet, professional workspace.

- Availability to work Monday to Friday during Sydney, Australia business hours.

- The ability to learn new systems and follow established processes.



We want this to be a long-term role, not just another job.



What you'll receive:

- Full-time remote employment.

- Warm leads only—no cold calling.

- Structured training and ongoing coaching.

description:
We're a Houston-based marketing agency that runs paid advertising campaigns for HVAC companies (heating, ventilation, and air conditioning). Our ads generate leads, homeowners who need AC repair, furnace installation, maintenance, etc. — and we need someone to qualify those leads and book appointments for our clients' sales teams.



This is not cold calling. These are warm/hot leads who already raised their hand by filling out a form or clicking on an ad.



What You'll Do

- Respond to incoming leads quickly (speed-to-lead is everything)

- Call, text, and follow up with warm leads to qualify them

- Ask the right questions to determine if they're a good fit (homeowner? timeline? budget? type of service needed?)

- Book qualified leads onto our clients' calendars

- Update and manage lead records inside our CRM (GoHighLevel or similar)

- Follow structured follow-up sequences — no lead falls through the cracks

- Track your numbers and report on daily activity (calls made, appointments set, show rates)



Who You Are

- Perfect English - spoken AND written. You will be calling US-based homeowners. Your English must be clear, natural, and confident on the phone. No heavy accent. This is the #1 requirement.

- Proven appointment setting or inside sales experience - you've done this before. You can handle objections, build rapport quickly, and move a conversation toward a booked appointment.

- Tech-comfortable - you can navigate CRMs (GoHighLevel, HubSpot, Salesforce, or similar), calendar tools (Calendly, Google Calendar), and aren't afraid to figure out new platforms on your own.

- Reliable and available 9 AM – 6 PM Central Time, Monday–Friday — no exceptions. This is a strict US business hours role.

- Self-motivated - you don't need to be micromanaged. You see a lead come in, you pick up the phone.





Bonus (not required, but a plus)

- Experience in home services lead gen (HVAC, plumbing, roofing, solar, etc.)

- Familiarity with GoHighLevel and any other CRMs

- Experience with speed-to-lead workflows

- Basic Spanish is a plus (many homeowners in Houston are Spanish-speaking)



To Apply

Please include:

1. A short loom video (1–2 minutes) introducing yourself in English, tell us about your appointment setting experience and why you're a good fit. This is required. Applications without a loom recording will not be reviewed.

2. Your experience with CRMs (which ones, how long)

3. Your current availability and confirmation you can work 9 AM – 6 PM Central Time

4. Please include your answer in your loom video: A homeowner fills out a form saying they need AC repair, but when you call them they say "I was just looking, I'm not really interested." What do you say?



Thanks!

mbers

title: Brand Film Director & AI Creative Systems Editor
description:
Read This Before You Apply

This is not a social media editing position.

This is not a content creator role.



This is not a "video editor" position.



We are building premium digital brands across multiple industries. Every project must establish credibility, communicate expertise, and create trust within seconds.



You'll create flagship website films, brand stories, product launches, recruiting campaigns, customer testimonials, corporate documentaries, executive interviews, and high-converting digital content.



If your work depends on templates, trendy transitions, or copying what is currently popular on social media, this role is not for you.



If your work consistently communicates emotion, trust, and authority through visual storytelling, we want to meet you.



Mission

Transform raw footage into premium brand assets that increase trust, engagement, and conversions.

Every project should answer three questions almost immediately:



Why should someone trust this company?

What makes this organization different?

Why should a customer choose them?

You will create films that become the centerpiece of websites, advertising campaigns, investor presentations, recruiting initiatives, and digital marketing systems.

What You'll Do

You'll receive footage from many different industries, including professional services, construction, healthcare, real estate, manufacturing, hospitality, education, technology, athletics, nonprofit organizations, and local businesses.

Your responsibility is not simply to edit footage.



Your responsibility is to discover and communicate the story hidden within it.



You will:



Review extensive libraries of raw video

Identify emotionally compelling moments

Build narrative through sequencing

Produce premium brand films

Create website hero videos

Develop customer testimonial videos

Produce executive interview content

Build recruiting and employer branding campaigns

Edit product launch videos

Produce social campaigns from flagship content

Deliver desktop, mobile, and social versions

Optimize all deliverables for performance across web platforms

Required Technical Expertise

Applicants should demonstrate mastery in most of the following.

Professional Editing

Adobe Premiere Pro

Adobe After Effects

DaVinci Resolve

CapCut Desktop (advanced proficiency)

Adobe Media Encoder

AI Production Workflow

You understand how AI accelerates professional production without replacing creative judgment.

Experience should include several of the following:



Adobe Firefly

Premiere AI

Runway

Topaz Video AI

AI object removal

AI stabilization

AI audio enhancement

AI scene detection

AI reframing

AI masking

AI transcript editing

AI workflow automation

Motion Design

Experience producing:

Logo animations

Motion graphics

Kinetic typography

Lower thirds

Interface animations

Infographics

Corporate presentation graphics

Cinematography Knowledge

You understand:

visual composition

lighting

movement

pacing

rhythm

color theory

shot selection

emotional sequencing

sound design

visual hierarchy

storytelling through editing

Brand Strategy

You understand the difference between:

A promotional video.



A corporate video.



A commercial.



A documentary.



A recruiting film.



A flagship brand story.



Every project should reinforce positioning, authority, and trust—not simply look attractive.



You Are Probably NOT a Fit If...

You primarily create:

TikTok edits

Instagram trend videos

Gaming montages

Wedding videos

Generic YouTube intros

Template-based reels

Fast-cut highlight compilations

We're looking for someone who builds brands—not someone who stacks clips together.

You ARE a Fit If...

You think like a filmmaker.

You edit with intention.



You understand when to slow down.



You understand when to create tension.



You understand when silence is more powerful than music.



You remove beautiful shots because they weaken the story.



You care more about narrative than effects.



You obsess over pacing.



You believe great editing is invisible.



Technical Deliverables

Ability to deliver:

4K masters

Website hero videos

Mobile-first versions

Social media derivatives

Optimized web compression

Motion graphic packages

Source project files

Color LUTs

Organized production assets

Bonus Qualifications

Experience with:

Drone cinematography

Corporate documentary production

Commercial advertising

High-end agency work

Product marketing

UI animation

Web video optimization

Photography

Sound design

Creative direction

Brand strategy

Creative AI workflows

Submission Requirements

Applications without the following will not be reviewed.

1. Portfolio

Provide five projects demonstrating different styles of storytelling.

2. Your Best Work

Submit the single best 30–60 second piece you've ever created.

3. Story Breakdown

For one portfolio piece, explain:

Why you selected each scene

Why each cut occurs where it does

How you created emotional progression

What business objective the film was designed to accomplish

4. Workflow

Describe your complete production workflow from raw footage through final delivery.

Include where AI assists your process and where creative judgment remains entirely manual.



5. Software Stack

List every tool you regularly use, including editing, motion graphics, AI, color grading, audio, asset management, and collaboration platforms.

Practical Evaluation

Finalists will receive identical raw footage from a real client.

Your assignment is to produce a flagship brand film suitable for the client's website.



We are not evaluating how many effects you can add.



We are evaluating your ability to:



Discover the story

Build trust

Create emotion

Communicate professionalism

Deliver a commercially effective brand asset

What We Value Most

Software can be learned.

Templates can be purchased.



AI can automate repetitive tasks.



Exceptional judgment cannot.



We're hiring someone who understands how visual storytelling influences perception, trust, and decision-making. The strongest candidates will consistently transform ordinary footage into compelling brand experiences that help businesses communicate credibility, differentiate themselves in competitive markets, and drive measurable business outcomes.

## Position Summary



We are hiring a senior-level engineer to design, build, deploy, secure, and maintain websites and web applications for multiple businesses.



These websites will integrate directly with GoHighLevel for CRM, lead capture, pipeline management, scheduling, automation, messaging, and customer communication.



This is not a basic web design role.



This is not a virtual assistant position.



This is not a role for someone whose experience is limited to building pages inside GoHighLevel.



We need a true full-stack engineer who can build secure production systems and integrate them cleanly with GoHighLevel.



## Primary Responsibilities



You will be responsible for:



* Designing and building secure websites for multiple businesses

* Developing front-end and back-end functionality

* Creating customer login portals and protected user areas

* Implementing two-factor authentication

* Building role-based access controls

* Managing user registration, login, password reset, and session security

* Integrating websites with GoHighLevel through APIs, webhooks, forms, calendars, workflows, and custom fields

* Connecting website activity to GHL contacts, opportunities, pipelines, and automations

* Building custom integrations using REST APIs, JSON, webhooks, Zapier, or Make

* Deploying websites to production

* Configuring domains, DNS, SSL certificates, and hosting

* Monitoring uptime, performance, errors, and security

* Maintaining backups and recovery procedures

* Troubleshooting website, database, authentication, and GHL integration failures

* Documenting architecture, integrations, credentials, and support procedures

* Supporting multiple client environments without data crossover or configuration conflicts



## Required Full-Stack Development Skills



You must have strong professional experience with:



* React or Next.js

* TypeScript

* JavaScript

* Node.js or an equivalent backend framework

* HTML5

* CSS3

* Responsive web development

* REST APIs

* JSON

* Database design

* PostgreSQL, MySQL, or an equivalent relational database

* Git

* GitHub or GitLab

* CI/CD pipelines

* Cloud deployment

* Production debugging



## Required Security and Authentication Skills



You must understand and have implemented:



* Two-factor authentication

* Multi-factor authentication

* TOTP-based authentication

* OAuth 2.0

* OpenID Connect

* JWT

* Secure session management

* Password hashing

* Password reset flows

* Role-based access control

* User permissions

* Authentication middleware

* Rate limiting

* Input validation

* Protection against common web vulnerabilities

* Secure handling of API keys and credentials

* Environment variable management

* SSL and HTTPS

* Logging and security monitoring



Experience with one or more of the following is strongly preferred:



* Auth0

* Clerk

* Firebase Authentication

* Supabase Auth

* AWS Cognito

* Auth.js

* NextAuth



## Required GoHighLevel Capabilities



You must be capable of working with:



* GoHighLevel contacts

* Opportunities

* Pipelines

* Calendars

* Forms

* Surveys

* Workflows

* Custom fields

* Tags

* User assignment

* Webhooks

* API integrations

* Lead routing

* Appointment workflows

*
 and SMS automation

* Sub-accounts

* SaaS mode

* Custom domains



You must be able to connect custom websites to GoHighLevel so that website activity triggers reliable CRM and automation behavior.



## Infrastructure and Deployment Skills



You should have hands-on experience with:



* AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, Vercel, Netlify, or similar platforms

* Cloudflare

* DNS management

* SSL certificates

* Domain configuration

* Docker

* Production deployments

* Staging environments

* Logging and monitoring

* Backup and recovery procedures

* Performance optimization

* Website security hardening



## Multi-Client Environment Requirements



You must be able to support multiple businesses while maintaining:



* Separate domains

* Separate credentials

* Separate databases or secure data isolation

* Separate GHL sub-accounts

* Separate deployment environments

* Clear documentation

* Secure access controls

* No client data crossover

* Repeatable build and deployment standards



## Performance Expectations



You will be expected to:



* Build production-ready websites without constant supervision

* Diagnose problems independently

* Produce secure and maintainable code

* Deliver stable GHL integrations

* Document every system you build

* Communicate technical issues clearly

* Manage multiple business websites simultaneously

* Escalate only genuinely advanced architectural or security issues

* Verify that every deployment works before declaring it complete



## Automatic Disqualifiers



Do not apply if:



* Your experience is limited to drag-and-drop website builders

* You have only built websites inside GoHighLevel

* You cannot build backend functionality

* You have never implemented authentication

* You have never implemented two-factor authentication

* You do not understand APIs and webhooks

* You cannot deploy a website to production

* You cannot configure DNS and SSL

* You cannot explain how you protect customer data

* You cannot provide live examples of production websites

* You require step-by-step supervision for routine engineering work

* You are unwilling to complete a technical assessment



## Application Requirements



Submit all of the following:



1. Resume

2. GitHub profile

3. Portfolio

4. Three live production websites you personally built

5. One example of a secure login or customer portal

6. One example involving two-factor authentication

7. One example of a GoHighLevel integration

8. A written explanation of your role in each project

9. A Loom video explaining the architecture of your most complex project

10. Desired hourly or monthly compensation

11. Availability during U.S. business hours



Applications missing required evidence will not be reviewed.



## Technical Assessment



Qualified candidates will be required to complete a practical assessment that may include:



* Building a secure login flow

* Implementing two-factor authentication

* Creating role-based access

* Connecting a website form to GoHighLevel

* Creating or updating a GHL contact

* Moving an opportunity through a pipeline

* Triggering a workflow through a webhook

* Deploying the application to a live environment

* Configuring SSL and DNS

* Documenting the complete solution



We are not hiring a page builder.



We are hiring an engineer who can build secure business systems and connect them to GoHighLevel.

title: Full-Time Electrical Design Engineer (Remote)
description:
Full-Time Electrical Design Engineer (Remote)



We are seeking a motivated and detail-oriented Electrical Design Engineer to join our team in a full-time remote position.



This is a long-term career opportunity for an engineer with experience in commercial and industrial electrical design who enjoys producing high-quality work and reviewing designs for accuracy.



**This is a permanent full-time position (40 hours per week). Applications from freelancers, agencies and candidates seeking part-time or project-based work will not be considered.**



## Responsibilities



* Design commercial and industrial electrical systems under the direction of the Senior Electrical Designer.

* Complete lighting designs using **AGi32**.

* Prepare lighting, power and single line drawings using AutoCAD.

* Complete electrical design calculations including:



  * Lighting calculations

  * Maximum demand

  * Cable sizing

  * Voltage drop

  * Fault level calculations

  * Protection device selection

* Prepare switchboard schedules and equipment schedules.

* Review electrical drawings and documentation for accuracy, completeness and compliance with project requirements.

* Identify drafting errors, design inconsistencies and coordination issues before drawings are issued.

* Review switchboard shop drawings for compliance with project specifications, single line diagrams and design intent.

* Verify protection devices, busbar ratings, fault ratings, metering arrangements and equipment selections.

* Review supplier technical submissions and shop drawings.

* Prepare technical mark-ups and coordinate design changes with suppliers and manufacturers.

* Review consultant drawings and identify potential clashes or design issues.

* Respond to design mark-ups, RFIs and technical queries.

* Assist with the preparation of complete design documentation packages.

* Maintain high standards of quality and attention to detail throughout the design process.

* Continuously improve design standards, templates and documentation.



## Essential Requirements



* Bachelor's Degree in Electrical Engineering.

* Minimum **3 years'** experience in commercial or industrial electrical design.

* Proficient in **AutoCAD**.

* **Proficient in AGi32 lighting design software (essential).**

* Demonstrated experience completing commercial and industrial lighting designs using AGi32.

* Strong understanding of electrical distribution systems.

* Experience completing:



  * Lighting calculations

  * Maximum demand calculations

  * Cable sizing

  * Voltage drop calculations

  * Fault level calculations

  * Protection device selection

* Experience reviewing switchboard shop drawings and electrical equipment submittals.

* Excellent attention to detail with the ability to identify errors, omissions and inconsistencies before drawings are issued.

* Ability to review drawings for technical accuracy, constructability and compliance.

* Strong written and spoken English.

* Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with the design team.

* Reliable high-speed internet connection.



## Highly Desirable



Experience with one or more of the following:



* PowerCAD

* ETAP

* Bluebeam

* Microsoft Excel

* Australian electrical design standards

* Commercial warehouse and industrial projects

* Design & Construct projects



## Personal Attributes



We are looking for someone who is:



* Reliable and committed.

* Organised and methodical.

* Highly detail-oriented.

* Proactive and solutions-focused.

* Comfortable reviewing and checking the work of others.

* Willing to ask questions when unsure.

* Able to work independently.

* Interested in a long-term career.



## Employment



* Full-time (40 hours per week).

* Permanent long-term position.

* Remote work.

* Flexible working hours with overlap during the Australian working day.

* Ongoing mentoring and technical development.

* Opportunity to grow into a senior design role over time.



## Application Requirements



Please include:



* Resume/CV.

* Portfolio or sample electrical drawings.

* At least one **AGi32 lighting design** that you have personally completed (including the calculation report and lighting layout where possible).

* Brief summary of your commercial or industrial design experience.

* List of software you are proficient in.

* Monthly salary expectation (USD).

* Earliest available start date.



**To demonstrate your attention to detail, please begin your application with the words "Design Review".**



Applications that do not demonstrate AGi32 experience or are seeking freelance or part-time work will not be considered.

Important: Selected applicants will receive a response within 24 hours. Due to the volume of applications, we may move forward with other candidates if we do not receive a timely response.



We are currently hiring for a long-term Remote Receptionist position. Responsibilities include answering inbound calls, scheduling appointments, de-escalating complaints, and completing administrative tasks in a fast-paced environment. This is a performance-based role where all calls are recorded and regularly audited for quality assurance.

(9) Briefly introduce yourself and describe the qualities, experiences, work habits, or achievements you believe genuinely set you apart from other applicants for this role.

title: Content Researcher & Scriptwriter
description:
About Logan & the brand

You'll be working on the content team behind Logan Fullmer — a distressed real estate investor, entrepreneur, and content creator who's building a fast-growing personal brand across social media, podcasting, and beyond. Our mission is simple: grow Logan's brand and turn his expertise and personality into content that reaches and resonates with a huge audience.

Right now, a lot of that content lives in the real estate world — but the brand is expanding, and so is the range of topics we cover. We're looking for someone who can research and write across whatever niche we point them at, not just one lane.

About the role

We need a sharp, curious content strategist to become the research and writing engine behind our short-form video content. You'll spend your days studying what's winning in our target topics, cracking the code on why it works, and turning that insight into scroll-stopping hooks, scripts, and content plans that our team takes out and shoots with Logan.

This role is specialized and nuanced — you won't be expected to know our world on day one. We'll train you on the subject matter and our system. What we can't train is a sharp mind, a great ear for language, and the instinct for a story. If that's you, we'll teach you the rest.

What you'll do



Research top-performing content across our target niches — reels, shorts, and viral formats — and break down exactly why the best of it works

Spot emerging trends, hooks, and formats before they peak

Write compelling, high-retention hooks and full scripts for talking-head and short-form video

Build out content plans and shot outlines for shoot days, so Logan and the videographer walk in knowing exactly what to capture

Develop a deep working knowledge of each topic we cover (starting with real estate)

Keep the content pipeline organized and running like a machine



What we're looking for



Exceptional English — near-native comprehension and writing. You understand nuance, tone, and rhythm at a very high level. This is non-negotiable.

A genuinely sharp mind — you think critically, connect dots fast, and go deep instead of staying surface-level

Storytelling ability — you know how to make an idea land with a real audience

Strong organization — you can manage a pipeline and hit deadlines without being chased

Attitude, aptitude, and bandwidth — you're coachable, hungry to learn a specialized craft, and you have the capacity to take it on



Nice to have (but not required)



Background in journalism, copywriting, or content marketing

Curiosity about business, real estate, or entrepreneurship



A few practical notes



This is a remote, full-time role working U.S. business hours (8am–5pm CDT)

title: Video Editor Wanted — Fully AI-Generated YouTube Channel
description:
Hey!

I'm looking for a skilled video editor/AI generalist to create long-form videos for my YouTube channel, The History of Everyday Objects. This is a fully AI-generated channel: the script and voice-over are AI-generated, and every visual in the video is also AI-generated — no real stock footage, archive photos, or historical images are used. Documentary-style, storytelling-focused content — think Crumb Lore and WeirdwardBound.


 


 


 



About this channel

This is a 100% AI YouTube channel: scripts are written by me, voice-over is AI-generated (not a human narrator), and all visuals are AI-generated (via Midjourney, DALL-E, Runway, Kling, Pika, or similar) — no real photos, archive footage, or stock clips

You will not need to record or direct any voice talent — the audio track is delivered to you ready to edit around

You will not need to source any real stock or archive footage — every scene is built from AI-generated images and video clips

Your job is to generate/prompt AI visuals for every scene in the script, then edit it all together with motion graphics and sound design

Please only apply if you're comfortable working entirely with AI-generated visuals and AI-narrated content — if that's not for you, no hard feelings, just let us know upfront



The job

title: Graphic Designer + Vibe Coder
description:
Full-Time | Remote | Creative Design + AI Tools + Web Design Support



We are looking for a creative, detail-oriented, and tech-forward Graphic Designer who can create strong visual work from scratch, not just edit templates.



This role is ideal for someone who has a strong eye for branding, layout, typography, color, and digital design. You should be comfortable creating designs for social media, websites, landing pages, ads, presentations, brand assets, and marketing materials.



We also want someone who is not afraid of newer creative tools. Experience with Figma, Photoshop, Illustrator, Cursor, Higgsfield, and Lovable is a strong plus. Figma is commonly used for collaborative design workflows, Adobe tools remain core for image editing and vector design, Cursor supports AI-assisted coding through natural language, Lovable helps build apps and websites through AI prompts, and Higgsfield supports AI video generation for marketing and content production.



Responsibilities



You will help with:



Creating graphics, layouts, and visual assets from scratch

Designing social media posts, ads, banners, thumbnails, and marketing materials

Creating website and landing page designs in Figma

Editing and enhancing images using Photoshop

Creating logos, icons, illustrations, and vector assets using Illustrator

Building clean, on-brand presentations, PDFs, and visual documents

Supporting UI/UX design for websites, landing pages, and simple web apps

Working with AI design and video tools like Higgsfield

Supporting basic “vibe coding” or web design workflows using Cursor and Lovable

Turning rough ideas, references, or written instructions into polished design outputs

Organizing design files properly and following brand guidelines

Requirements



We are looking for someone with:



Proven experience as a Graphic Designer, Visual Designer, Brand Designer, or similar role

Strong portfolio showing original design work

Ability to create designs from scratch, not just copy templates

Strong experience with Figma

Strong experience with Adobe Photoshop

Strong experience with Adobe Illustrator

Good understanding of layout, typography, spacing, color, and visual hierarchy

Experience creating social media graphics, ads, web graphics, and branded assets

Ability to follow brand guidelines and create consistent visual systems

Strong attention to detail

Good written English communication

Ability to receive feedback and revise designs quickly

Organized file management and ability to work with deadlines

Nice to Have



These are not required, but would be a strong plus:



Experience with Cursor

Experience with Lovable

Experience with Higgsfield

Experience with AI image or video generation tools

Basic understanding of landing pages, UI/UX, and responsive web design

Experience designing for healthcare, wellness, e-commerce, agencies, or service businesses

Experience creating short-form video assets, ad creatives, or motion-style concepts

Basic knowledge of Canva is fine, but this role requires stronger design tools beyond Canva

Ideal Candidate



You are creative, organized, fast-moving, and detail-oriented. You can take a rough idea and turn it into a polished design without needing every detail explained.



You should have strong design taste, but also be practical. We need someone who can create beautiful work that is also useful for marketing, websites, sales materials, and business communication.



Work Schedule



This is a full-time remote role. You must be able to communicate clearly, meet deadlines, and work with consistent availability.



Please include your availability and preferred work schedule in your application.



How to Apply



To be considered, please follow the instructions below.



Required Subject Line



Use this exact subject line:



GRAPHIC DESIGNER - [Your Full Name]



Required Loom Video



Please send a 3–5 minute Loom video answering the following:



Briefly introduce yourself.

Walk us through 2–3 of your best portfolio pieces.

Explain which tools you used to create them.

Share your experience with Figma, Photoshop, and Illustrator.

Mention any experience with Cursor, Lovable, Higgsfield, AI design tools, or web design.

Explain why you would be a strong fit for this role.

Include in Your Application

Resume or work experience summary

Portfolio link

Loom video link

Tools you have used

Relevant design experience

Availability and preferred schedule

Important



Applications without the required portfolio will not be entertained.

Applications without the required Loom video will not be entertained.

Applications without the correct subject line will not be entertained.



We are looking for someone who can follow instructions, create strong original designs, and bring creative ideas to life with both traditional design tools and modern AI tools.

title: Client Onboarding & Sales Coordinator
description:
We're a U.S. healthcare compliance and telehealth infrastructure company. We're looking for a sharp, extremely detail-oriented coordinator to turn our incoming leads into signed, onboarded clients — and to keep every single deal tracked from first contact all the way through go-live and monthly billing. You'll work directly with the founder on all of these projects.

Professional-level spoken and written English required; clear American accent strongly preferred.



What you'll do

? Make sure every client agreement is sent, signed, and tracked to completion

? Maintain a live pipeline/tracker — every lead, every next step, every invoice, every signature

? Handle ongoing client touchpoints and monthly billing coordination

What we're looking for

? Extreme attention to detail and disciplined tracking — this role genuinely does not work without both. Nothing can be allowed to fall through the cracks.

? Excellent written and spoken English, with a professional and friendly client manner

? Experience in sales coordination, onboarding, client success, or account management (B2B services, SaaS, healthcare, or med spa/aesthetics is a big plus)

? Comfortable with spreadsheets, CRMs, scheduling, and invoicing tools — and quick to learn new systems (you'll be trained on our GFE and onboarding platform)

? A reliable self-starter who follows through without being chased

? Available during U.S. business hours — Pacific Time

Nice to have

? Familiarity with healthcare compliance, med spas, or the aesthetics industry

? Experience with invoicing (e.g., Stripe) and a CRM/pipeline tool (HubSpot, Pipedrive, or similar)

Details

? Location: Remote



How to apply

Because this role is all about detail and follow-through, please:

1. Start your application with the word "DETAIL" so we know you read the full post.

2. Briefly describe a time you managed a detailed pipeline, onboarding process, or set of deadlines — and how you made sure nothing slipped.

3. Tell us about your client-communication and sales-coordination experience.

4. Include your availability, time zone, and rate.

5.     Send a short 1-2 mins video recording to describe your credentials



We read every application carefully — the people who pay attention to the details here are exactly who we want to hear from.

This is a stable, long-term contractor position, not a short-term gig. The right candidate will work directly with the firm owner (Jeff White) and will become a long-term extension of our bookkeeping team.

Strong written and spoken English (you'll be communicating with the firm owner in writing daily)

QuickBooks Online: You will need your own QuickBooks Online account and login. Company will provide access to the appropriate clients within the firm's QBO account.

: All firm communication runs through your personal

 prohibition)

 is permanently prohibited as a channel for client communication at all times

 the following:

 your application and answers together to

15. Engagement Capacity

Are you able to take this engagement on in addition to your current workload?

__________________________________________________

Section D: Written Communication (3 questions)

16.
 Tone

A client
s you angry because their books are messy. They use ALL CAPS and call your work "garbage." Write the first 2-3 sentences of your reply
.

17. Status Report

Write a 3-sentence weekly status report for a client whose August reconciliation is on track but their credit card reconciliation is 2 days behind.

Proofread this sentence and rewrite it correctly: "the clients books was reciled last month and there balance sheet is out of balance by 200 dollars"

__________________________________________________

Graphic Designer (DTC / eCommerce)



Every role in our company exists to drive measurable impact. We are looking for individuals who take ownership, operate with urgency, and think in terms of results. You will be trusted with responsibility and expected to deliver against clear performance metrics.



**About the Role

We're looking for a Graphic Designer with hands-on experience creating for DTC / eCommerce brands who can concept, design, and iterate on high-performing ad creatives that drive engagement, strengthen our brand, and support marketing growth.



Design is one of our most important growth levers, especially across paid social and digital marketing. Right now, design work is fragmented and slows down creative output. This role exists to bring consistency, speed, and quality to our visual production process.



As our Graphic Designer, you will develop and produce polished visual assets ready for distribution across multiple platforms, helping the marketing team ship better creative, faster.



?? This Role Is NOT for You If:

- Your experience is primarily in print design.

- You have not worked with DTC / eCommerce brands or performance-driven creatives

- You are not comfortable using AI image generation tools as part of your daily workflow



**What You'll Be Responsible For

- Developing creative concepts and designing ad visuals from brief to final deliverable

- Generating and iterating on visuals using AI image generation tools

- Adapting and editing existing designs, copy swaps, layout variations, resizes, and format adjustments

- Exporting and formatting design deliverables optimized for different platforms

- Maintaining consistent visual quality and brand style across all creative output

- Editing and producing AppLovin End Cards optimized for mobile ad performance

- Creating and editing GIFs for use across paid social and digital marketing channels

- Designing and adapting website images - banners, landing page visuals, and promotional graphics

- Designing and iterating on packaging designs in line with brand guidelines and campaign needs

- Organizing and managing design project files and asset libraries



**This Role Does NOT Include

- Content strategy or campaign planning

- Video editing

- Photography or product shooting

- Channel performance analytics



**What We Offer / Support You’ll Receive

- We want our designers to have the right tools, setup, and team environment to do their best work. As part of the role, you’ll get access to practical support that helps you create high-performing video ads efficiently:

- Tool reimbursement for relevant creative tools such as Adobe, Envato, Storyblocks, and similar platforms

- Access to our in-house hosted AI image & video generation tool

- Bonus compensation for creatives that perform especially well

- A strong creative team around you, including 3 graphic designers, 30+ video editors, Marketing Project Manager for coordination and support, and multiple Creative Strategists to collaborate with

After 30 Days

- You can independently concept and produce short-form ad creatives

After 60 Days

- You fully own the end-to-end design of assigned creatives

- You manage your own asset files and project organization independently

- You consistently deliver platform-optimized visuals across formats

- You are actively contributing creative ideas, not just executing briefs



After 90 Days

- Design output speed has increased significantly

- Standard ad formats are produced at competitive speed without sacrificing quality

- Most designs pass quality control within two revision cycles

- Visual output is consistent across all projects

- The marketing team has a reliable, proactive creative partner



**Failure Signals

- Consistently missing deadlines

- Repeated revisions required for basic execution issues

- Inability to match brand style, visual tone, or ad format requirements

- Requiring constant direction to complete assigned tasks

- Avoiding ownership of problems or blockers

- Resistance to using or improving AI-assisted workflows



**What We're Looking For

Experience

- 2–5+ years of experience in graphic design for social media, digital marketing, or DTC / eCommerce brands

- Proven track record creating high-performing static ad creatives for paid social



**Skills

*You already demonstrate:

- Strong ability to develop creative concepts for ads and visuals — not just execute briefs

- Deep understanding of what makes ad creatives perform on social media

- Ability to replicate and iterate on existing design styles and references

- Fast, efficient workflow without compromising visual quality

- Strong attention to detail across typography, layout, and composition

- Awareness of current design and advertising trends

- Ability to create or adapt packaging designs

- Experience with eCommerce or DTC brands specifically



**Tools

*You should already be comfortable using:

- AI image generation: Midjourney, Nanobanana or equivalent - including advanced prompting

- Adobe Photoshop - for compositing, retouching, and final adjustments

- Adobe Aftereffects

- Adobe Illustrator - for vector work and layout

- Canva



**Ownership & Collaboration

*In this role, you will own:

- Creative concepting and design execution end-to-end

- Exporting and formatting deliverables for different platforms

- Managing your design project files and asset organization

- Maintaining visual consistency across all creative output



**You will primarily collaborate with:



- Director of Ops

- Marketing Project Manager

- Creative Strategists



**Soft Skills We Value

- High reliability — you meet deadlines and flag blockers early

- Proactive communication — you don't go quiet when things get difficult

- Strong ownership mindset — you treat the work as your own

- Openness to suggesting and implementing AI workflow improvements



**Working Conditions

Schedule: Monday–Friday, 8am–5pm (GMT+4)

Location: Remote

Employment Type: Full-time

Contract: Independent contractor agreement



**Application Requirements

To apply, you must include:

A portfolio and work samples demonstrating your DTC / eCommerce design work (paid ads, social ads, etc.)

Examples of AI-generated visuals or AI-assisted creative work



**Our Hiring Process

We run a structured, performance-focused hiring process designed to assess real capability and mutual fit.

How to Apply

 and SMS automation

 and SMS follow-up sequences

s and onboarding instructions

* Create quality-control checklists

### Help Organize the Company

 accounts and internal tools

* Create task-management boards

* Research tools, software, competitors, and service opportunities

## Required Experience



* Hands-on experience with GoHighLevel

, and SMS systems

## Preferred Experience

THIS IS A REPOST OF A RECENT JOB OPENING.  WE BUILD IN THE MOUNTAINS AND NEED SOMEONE WHO REALLY UNDERSTANDS TOPO.  IF YOU CAN USE NC ONEMAP TO PULL TOPO LINES AND PARCEL DATA INTO A 3D TOPO FOR HOME DESIGN AND UNDERSTAND CUT & FILL AND BUILDING IN AREAS OF TOPO PLEASE APPLY.  I have a couple of talented architects but we also need someone who understands US building standards and topo.



Since this is a remote position some of these requirements will be tweaked.  You would be communicating with our team and clients remotely via
, WhatsApp, and possibly via video on FaceTime or Zoom.  I may tweak this description as I see what responses I get.  Thank you for taking the time to apply and for giving me all the info I need to make a great decision.



Job Description

Who We Are

We are a small design-build custom home and renovation firm based in NC, serving the mountains of Western North Carolina. We handle everything in-house, from initial design through final construction, which means our designer isn't handing drawings off to someone else and walking away. You're part of the build from first sketch to finished product.

We're a small, high-performing team that takes on fewer projects intentionally so we can do each one right. I have found that I need to include a bit of detail in the job post to see if you actually read it all.  I find that at least 50% don't read it all.  If you skip over all of these it means you are just blasting out responses and have no attention to detail and I will delete your application. Our clients are homeowners and investors who expect precision, professionalism, and a design partner who listens. We've built our reputation on doing exactly that.



The Role

We're looking for an Architectural Designer who brings real expertise and takes ownership of the design function. You'll work directly with clients from early concept through construction documentation, collaborating daily with our project managers and pre-construction team. You'll be in the “room” virtually” if needed for the conversations that matter.

We want someone who brings strong judgment, exercises initiative, and raises the quality of our work.



What You'll Do

Lead design development across all phases, from initial programming and schematic concepts through design development and construction documentation

Understand client design meetings and selections appointments, work with our interior designer and clients through material, finish, and specification decisions across multiple rounds

Produce construction drawings and documentation that our project managers can build from without ambiguity

Create renderings and visual presentations that communicate design intent clearly to clients

In your response, tell me the difference between European & US style windows.

Collaborate with pre-construction on design-driven cost estimates and value engineering decisions

Maintain design intent through the build by staying engaged with the field team during construction

In your response, tell me what hourly rate you need and your minimum and maximum hours you would work.

Contribute to improving our internal design process as the company grows



What We're Looking For

5+ years of experience in residential design, preferably custom homes or high-end renovation

Required proficiency in Revit, AutoCAD, and SketchUp or other similar software

In your response tell me how big a 2x4 and a 2x10 is.

Experience producing high-quality renderings for client presentations

Working knowledge of US residential building codes and construction methods; familiarity with North Carolina codes is a plus

A portfolio that demonstrates design sensibility, complete construction documents, and client-ready renderings

In your response, tell me the clearances required for bathroom fixtures.

Clear communicator who handles client relationships with confidence and works well without heavy oversight

In your response, tell me why you are the right fit for this role.

Familiarity with design-build delivery is a plus; genuine interest in how buildings get built is non-negotiable

Bonus if you bring experience with: Rhino 3D, Grasshopper, ArchiCAD, Chief Architect, Adobe Creative Suite, or Bluebeam



Salary

Please provide your required hourly rate.



Why This Role

You'll have direct influence over a company's design direction, not executing someone else's vision as one of many. You'll work with a team that respects craft, holds high standards, and takes pride in the finished product. 



To Apply

Send a sample of your work that would be ready to permit in the US market.  Apply directly through Onlinejobs.ph. Include your portfolio with your application, demonstrating your design work, construction documents, and renderings. Applications without a portfolio will not be considered.

description:

This is a repeatable template role, not a creative freelance role. I give you the style. Your job is to reproduce it exactly, 3 videos per day, without it drifting.



THE WORK:

- 3 finished videos per day, ~35–55 seconds each, vertical 1080p.

- You work from AI-generated cooking clips I provide (light AI involvement — you're NOT the one generating, you're assembling and animating).

- Sequence the clips step-by-step to match the recipe.

- KEYFRAME everything: smooth punch-ins, zooms, pans, scale/position animation, tracked movement so every clip feels dynamic and satisfying. This is the main skill I'm hiring for.

- Add clean on-screen step + ingredient text in the locked template style.

- Sync cuts to trending/satisfying audio. Strong hook in the first 2 seconds.

- Write the caption (full recipe + hashtags).



CORE SKILLS REQUIRED:

- Expert CapCut keyframing — this is non-negotiable. If you can't animate position/scale/rotation smoothly, this isn't for you.

- Ability to replicate a reference style EXACTLY and repeat it 90+ times a month without quality drop.

- Fast, reliable daily turnaround. Consistency > creativity.

- Basic understanding of TikTok hooks, retention, and pacing.



I PROVIDE:

- The AI cooking clips / assets.

- The recipe list.

- A locked style reference + template to match.



TO APPLY:

- Start your message with the word "KEYFRAME" so I know you read this.

- Send 2 samples that clearly show your keyframing/animation work (not just cuts).

- Tell me your realistic output per day and your rate (per video or monthly).



Low-effort or copy-paste applications will be ignored.
