title: Customer Support Virtual Assistant for Shopify and Social Media
description:
**Location:** Remote – Philippines

**Working Hours:** 8:30 AM to 4:30 PM, Melbourne time

**Business:** Food Voyageur – Premium Celebration Cake Company



Food Voyageur is looking for a highly organised, intelligent, and detail-focused Virtual Assistant to join our fast-paced customer service and operations team.



This is **not a simple administration or data-entry role**.



We create cakes for birthdays, weddings, corporate events, and important life celebrations. Every customer order has multiple details and operational touchpoints that must be carefully considered. Some customers may also have dietary requirements or serious allergies, so accuracy, communication, and good judgement are essential.



We need someone who can think through an order from beginning to end—not someone who works blindly, simply ticks boxes, or waits to be told every next step.



Full training will be provided, but you must be able to learn extremely quickly, retain information, adapt, and confidently apply what you have learned.



## Key Responsibilities



### Customer Service and Sales



* Respond quickly and professionally to enquiries received through:



  *
 Messenger

  * Instagram

  *

  * Phone calls

* Assist customers with new cake enquiries and existing orders.

* Ask the correct questions to understand the customer’s requirements.

* Recommend suitable cake options and confidently convert enquiries into sales.

* Follow up with customers who have not completed their order or payment.

* Keep up with
s, messages, phone calls, and customer follow-ups throughout the day.

* Handle customer requests for order changes carefully and accurately.



### Order Entry and Invoicing



* Enter all customer and cake information accurately into the CRM.

* Prepare and send invoices to customers.

* Confirm that important details are complete, including:



  * Customer name and contact details

  * Delivery or collection date

  * Correct delivery address

  * Cake size and number of serves

  * Flavour

  * Design and colour requirements

  * Personalised wording

  * Dietary requirements

  * Nut allergies or other allergy information

  * Delivery instructions

  * Venue or restaurant information

  * Any special requests

* Review the full order before sending the invoice or confirming the booking.

* Identify missing, unclear, or conflicting information and contact the customer for clarification.



### Shopify and CRM Management



* Create, review, and update orders in Shopify.

* Ensure information is consistent across both Shopify and the CRM.

* When a customer requests a change, update every required system—not just one location.

* Add clear internal notes so the production, customer service, and delivery teams all receive the same information.

* Double-check that changes have been correctly saved and communicated.

* Never assume that updating one system automatically updates everything else.



### Delivery Planning and Driver Coordination



* Review upcoming deliveries in advance and prepare for busy delivery days.

* Create delivery routes and assign deliveries to drivers.

* Check that every address is accurate and complete.

* Confirm whether the delivery location is a home, restaurant, hotel, function venue, or wedding venue.

* Inform customers when additional venue information or delivery instructions are required.

* Organise routes logically based on location, timing, cake type, and customer requirements.

* Prepare ahead for busy Saturdays that may have 20 or more deliveries.

* Give special attention to wedding deliveries, ensuring the route and timing protect the couple’s experience and event schedule.

* Consider access instructions, venue opening times, parking, loading areas, delivery windows, and the safe handling of cakes.



## This Role Requires You to Think



When processing an order, you must consider the entire customer journey.



For example:



* Has the customer provided the correct date?

* Is the address complete and valid?

* Is the cake being delivered to a restaurant or venue?

* Does the venue know a cake is arriving?

* Has the customer provided the recipient’s phone number?

* Are there allergies or dietary requirements?

* Has the allergy information been clearly recorded?

* Are the cake details consistent across Shopify, the CRM, the invoice, and internal notes?

* Has a requested change been updated everywhere?

* Does the delivery require a specific arrival time?

* Is the delivery route practical and safe for the cake?

* Is there any information the kitchen, driver, or customer service team still needs?



You must be able to identify potential problems before they become customer complaints.



## Who We Are Looking For



The successful candidate must be:



* Extremely attentive to detail.

* A fast learner who can pick up systems and processes quickly.

* Confident using Shopify.

* Experienced with CRM systems, customer service, or order management.

* Strong in written and spoken English.

* Comfortable answering customer phone calls.

* Confident in sales and following up with customers.

* Able to remain calm under pressure.

* Proactive and able to work without constant supervision.

* Organised and able to manage multiple enquiries and orders at once.

* Comfortable working in a very fast-paced environment.

* Able to use judgement rather than blindly following a checklist.

* Responsible when handling allergy and dietary information.

* Able to communicate clearly with customers, kitchen staff, management, and delivery drivers.

* Willing to take ownership and follow an issue through until it is resolved.



## Essential Experience



* Shopify experience.

* Customer service experience.

* Sales experience.

*
 and inbox management.

*
 and Instagram messaging.

* Phone-based customer service or sales.

* CRM or order-management experience.

* Accurate data entry and invoicing.

* Strong computer and online system skills.



Experience in food, hospitality, events, weddings, e-commerce, delivery coordination, or customised products would be highly regarded.



## Important



This role is not suitable for someone who:



* Works mechanically without thinking.

* Rushes through customer orders.

* Does not double-check their work.

* Struggles to manage multiple tasks.

* Avoids phone calls or customer follow-ups.

* Needs to be repeatedly reminded about the same process.

* Updates one system but forgets to update another.

* Waits for problems to happen instead of preventing them.

* Is uncomfortable working under pressure.



Our customers trust us with important celebrations. A missed detail can affect a birthday, a wedding, a venue delivery, or a customer with an allergy. We therefore expect a very high level of care, responsibility, and accuracy.



## Training



We will provide training on Food Voyageur’s systems, products, processes, cake requirements, invoicing, delivery planning, and customer service standards.



However, you must be able to:



* Learn quickly.

* Take detailed notes.

* Remember processes.

* Ask intelligent questions.

* Apply feedback immediately.

* Improve without needing the same correction repeatedly.

Applications that do not include this sentence may not be considered.

We're looking for an Operations VA to help keep our automated business systems running smoothly across our supplement and cybersecurity brands, and to handle day-to-day communication with our supplement supplier. This is a monitoring, maintenance, and coordination role — you're not producing content or closing sales deals, you're making sure the systems and supply chain that support the business stay healthy, and flagging anything that needs attention.



What you'll do:

- Daily checks on our
 sending, lead scraping, and ad tracking tools — confirm everything is connected and running, flag anything disconnected or erroring

- Communicate regularly with our supplement supplier — check in on order status, respond to routine questions about quantities, timelines, and specs, and keep us updated on anything relevant

- Escalate any supplier conversation involving pricing changes, contract terms, or quality issues immediately rather than handling it yourself

- Build and maintain
 marketing flows (welcome series, abandoned cart, post-purchase) using Klaviyo — training provided if you haven't used it before

- Monitor and execute paid ad campaigns on a small number of priority channels — load creative, check spend pacing, pause underperforming ad sets

- Weekly reporting: a short summary of system health, supplier updates,
 performance, and ad results

- Escalate anything broken or unusual immediately rather than waiting for the weekly report



What we're looking for:

- Detail-oriented and comfortable with dashboards/analytics tools

- Reliable and proactive about flagging issues before they become bigger problems

- Comfortable communicating professionally with a business supplier/vendor

- Some experience with
 marketing tools (Klaviyo or similar) is a plus, not required — training provided

- Comfortable using Airtable, spreadsheets, and following documented processes

- Reliable internet connection

- Able to work independently and complete weekly checks on schedule, even on a part-time basis



This is a flexible, part-time role requiring approximately 15-20 hours per week. Certain checks and supplier follow-ups need to happen on a regular schedule even though overall hours are part-time — reliability on timing matters more than total hours.



Starting pay is $200 per month. Pay increases over time based on performance.



Please do not include personal contact information in your application. We will follow up through OnlineJobs.ph if you are a good fit.

title: Video Editor
description:
I am looking for a hungry, aggressive Video Editor who understands how to SELL, not just make things look "pretty." You will be creating high-converting video ads (Meta ads/ TikTok) for a fast-growing e-commerce brand. If you don't know what a "Hook," "Pacing," or "CTA" is, close this page right now. I need a killer, not an artist.



What You Will Do (The 20% that drives 80% of revenue):

Scroll-Stopping Hooks: Craft the first 3 seconds that violently force people to stop scrolling.

Fast-Paced Editing: Keep the energy high. Cut the fluff. If it doesn't drive a sale, it gets deleted.

Direct Response Focus: Use text overlays, trending audio, and psychological triggers to drive clicks.

Rapid A/B Testing: Rip apart winning videos, change the hooks, and iterate fast.

What You Need (No bullshit requirements):

Proven experience in dropshipping/e-commerce video ads. (You MUST show a portfolio of WINNING ads).

Mastery of Premiere Pro, CapCut, or Final Cut.

Deep understanding of TikTok/Reels native culture, memes, and trends.

Ability to work fast and iterate based on hard performance data (ROAS, CPA).



How to Apply:

Do NOT send a generic cover letter. I will delete it. Send me your top 3 best-performing e-commerce ads and tell me exactly WHY they converted. Start your message with the word "HOOK" so I know you can read instructions.

title: Video Editor (DTC / eCommerce Ads)
description:
Video Editor (DTC / eCommerce Ads)



Every role in our company exists to drive measurable impact.

We are looking for individuals who take ownership, operate with urgency, and think in terms of results. You will be trusted with responsibility and expected to deliver against clear performance metrics.



**About the Role

We’re looking for a Video Editor with experience editing for DTC / ecommerce brands who can turn raw footage into high-quality video content that drives engagement, strengthens our brand, and supports marketing growth.



Video is one of our most important growth channels, especially across paid social and digital marketing. Right now, editing work is fragmented and slows down content output. This role exists to bring consistency, speed, and quality to our video production process.

As the Video Editor, you will turn raw recordings into polished video assets ready for distribution across multiple platforms, helping the marketing team ship content faster and at a higher quality.



?? This Role Is NOT for You If:

- Your experience is primarily in YouTube or cinematic.

- You have not worked with DTC / ecommerce brands or performance-driven content

- You prefer developing creative concepts over executing and iterating on performance-driven ad creatives



**What You’ll Be Responsible For

- Editing assigned video content from raw footage to final deliverable

- Exporting video deliverables optimized for different platforms

- Managing and organizing editing project files and raw footage

- Maintaining consistent editing quality and visual style across all content



**This Role Does NOT Include

- Content strategy

- Script writing

- Filming or recording

- Channel performance analytics



**What we offer / support you’ll receive

We want our editors to have the right tools, setup, and team environment to do their best work. As part of the role, you’ll get access to practical support that helps you create high-performing video ads efficiently:

- Tool reimbursement for relevant creative tools such as Adobe, Envato, Storyblocks, and similar platforms

- Access to our in-house hosted AI video generation tool

- Bonus compensation for creatives that perform especially well

A strong creative team around you, including 30+ video editors, 2 Graphic Designers, Marketing Project Manager for coordination and support, and multiple Creative Strategists to collaborate with



**Growth opportunities

As the company grows, top-performing editors have the opportunity to progress into Senior Video Editor positions and, if additional leadership roles are created in the future, potentially Team Lead positions.



You will work alongside a large team of Video Editors, Marketing Project Managers, and Creative Strategists, providing exposure to how high-performing DTC brands operate at scale.

While this role is not intended as a direct pathway into Creative Strategy, we evaluate people based on their capabilities rather than their job title. If someone consistently demonstrates strong creative strategy skills, we are open to exploring opportunities that align with both their strengths and the company's needs.



**What Success Looks Like

After 30 Days

- You understand the company’s content style and brand tone

- You can independently edit short-form and long-form ads

- You use the company’s editing workflow and AI tools without supervision

- Your edits are delivered on time and require minimal revisions

After 60 Days

- You fully own the end-to-end editing of assigned content

- You manage raw footage and project files independently

- You deliver content optimized for different platforms

After 90 Days

- Content production speed has increased significantly

- Standard ad formats (e.g., VSL / ElevenLabs ads) are delivered at competitive speed while maintaining quality

- Most edits pass quality control within two revision cycles

- Video output is consistent across projects

- The marketing team has a reliable editing partner



**Failure Signals

- Consistently missing deadlines

- Repeated revisions required for basic issues

- Inability to match brand style or pacing

- Requiring constant direction to complete tasks

- Avoiding ownership of problems



**What We’re Looking For

*Experience

- 2–5+ years of experience editing video content

- Experience editing content for social media, digital marketing, or DTC / ecommerce brands



*Skills

You already demonstrate:

- Professional video editing

- Strong storytelling through pacing and cuts

- Short-form and long-form video editing

- Captioning and video formatting

- Strong attention to detail and editing quality



*Tools

You should already be comfortable using:

- Adobe Premiere Pro

- CapCut

- Basic motion graphics tools (After Effects or equivalent)



**Ownership & Collaboration

In this role, you will own:

- Editing assigned video content end-to-end

- Exporting deliverables for different platforms

- Managing editing project files

- Maintaining video style consistency



You will primarily collaborate with:

- Director of Ops

- Marketing Manager

- Creative Strategists



**Working Conditions

Schedule: Monday–Friday, 8am–5pm (GMT+4)

Location: Remote



**Employment Type: Full-time

Contract: Independent contractor agreement

*Application Requirements

To apply, you must include:

- A portfolio and work samples demonstrating your DTC / ecommerce editing work (paid ads, social ads, etc.)



**Our Hiring Process

We run a structured, performance-focused hiring process designed to assess real capability and mutual fit.

Step 1: Initial Application & Portfolio Review

Step 2: Practical Test Task (To evaluate speed, quality, and technical alignment)

Step 3: Initial Screening Interview

Step 4: Official Job Offer

This role provides high level support for a top producing agent managing a substantial transaction volume across both retail and foreclosure properties.



This position requires someone who can independently manage the full lifecycle of a real estate transaction while keeping timelines protected, files compliant, and communication flowing. The ideal candidate is proactive, detail focused, dependable, and comfortable operating in a fast paced environment where accuracy and follow through are critical.



Primary responsibilities include overseeing buyer and seller transactions from executed contract through closing, preparing listing documentation and purchase contracts, and supporting MLS entry and maintenance. This role schedules and confirms inspections, appraisals, walkthroughs, and closings, while actively monitoring deadlines to ensure documents are executed on time. All transaction files are maintained in Transact and 
, with organized storage and tracking in Google Drive. Regular communication with closing attorneys, lenders, inspectors, vendors, and internal tea
mbers is required, and all files must consistently meet compliance standards.



Client communication is an essential component of this role. The Transaction Coordinator serves as a primary operational contact for clients, providing timely updates, milestone reminders, and status communication throughout the transaction. This includes thoughtful check ins, post closing follow ups, and coordination of client related details. All communication and follow up actions must be documented in the CRM to ensure continuity and accountability.



Listing and marketing support is also part of this position. Responsibilities include coordinating photography, video, signage, print materials, and listing pages. The role assists with creating and scheduling branded marketing assets using Canva, supports
 and newsletter distribution, and prepares marketing packages that align with established brand standards.



Administrative responsibilities include managing calendars and inboxes, scheduling appointments, preparing presentations, market summaries, and client reports, maintaining well organized digital files within Google Drive, and tracking tasks and workflows in 
. This role may also support special projects and operational initiatives as needed.



Qualified candidates will have a minimum of 5 years of experience as a Real Estate Transaction Coordinator with US based real estate experience. Proven ability to manage transactions independently from contract to close is required, along with professional references. A strong background in retail residential sales is necessary, and experience with foreclosure, REO, or short sale transactions is a significant advantage. Hands on experience with MLS platforms is required, with FlexMLS experience strongly preferred. Candidates must be able to manage 20 or more active transactions at once while maintaining accuracy and quality.



Experience working within a mortgage or title environment is highly valued, including prior roles involving underwriting, file review, or transaction oversight. Arizona market experience is preferred.



The ideal candidate is self directed, proactive, growth oriented, and receptive to feedback. They perform well under pressure, communicate clearly and professionally in English, and maintain consistent attendance. Availability on weekends is expected when transaction timelines require it. Candidates with children must have dependable childcare in place during working hours to ensure focus and productivity.



Work from home requirements include a quiet professional workspace, a computer with an i5 or Ryzen 5 processor or newer, at least 8 GB of RAM, Windows 10 or newer, a wired internet connection with minimum speeds of 15 Mbps, a noise canceling headset, and an HD webcam. Ability to work Mountain Time hours between 8 AM and 5 PM is required.



Important note: This role requires the ability to independently manage transaction coordination, contract preparation, listing support, and client communication. Applicants without the required experience will not be considered.



How to respond: If you are interested and meet the qualifications above, please reply with a brief message outlining your years of Transaction Coordinator experience, the MLS platforms you have used, your experience managing transactions from contract to close, and whether you have worked with foreclosure or REO properties. Qualified candidates will receive a link to formally apply. Initial responses are required before an application link will be provided.

title: Home Services Marketing Manager and Meta Ads Specialist
description:
Job Overview



We are a growing home remodeling company looking for an experienced Marketing Manager and Paid Ads Specialist to take ownership of our lead generation and marketing systems.



Our services include:



Roofing

Siding

Exterior painting

Interior remodeling

Other residential home improvement services



Over the past several years, we have spent hundreds of thousands of dollars on marketing and paid advertising. We already have campaigns, data, creatives, landing pages, CRM systems, and marketing processes in place.



We are not looking for a beginner or someone who only knows how to launch basic
 ads.



We need someone who can come in, complete a full audit of our current marketing, identify what is working, find areas that need improvement, and help us build a more efficient lead generation system.



This is a high-level and well-paying opportunity for someone who has the right experience, communication skills, and ability to produce results.



The position will begin part-time with the opportunity to grow into a full-time role.



Main Responsibilities



You will help manage and improve our overall digital marketing operation, including:



Auditing our current Meta advertising account and campaign structure

Creating, launching, and managing
 and Instagram ad campaigns

Optimizing campaigns to improve lead quality and lower cost per lead

Testing new audiences, offers, ad copy, creatives, landing pages, and lead forms

Reviewing previous campaign data and identifying opportunities for improvement

Developing new advertising concepts and promotional offers

Helping create static image ads, video ad concepts, hooks, headlines, and copy

Managing Meta Instant Forms and website conversion campaigns

Building and improving landing pages

Tracking leads and conversions throughout the customer journey

Helping improve our GoHighLevel CRM setup

Building or improving automations, pipelines, workflows,
 sequences, and SMS follow-up

Reviewing lead quality and helping identify where leads are being lost

Creating clear marketing reports and communicating campaign performance

Potentially helping manage or improve Google Ads campaigns

Researching additional lead generation opportunities for the home services industry

Required Experience



You should have proven experience with several of the following:



Meta Ads Manager

 and Instagram lead generation

Home services, roofing, remodeling, construction, solar, HVAC, real estate, or similar local service industries

Meta Instant Forms

Landing page optimization

Lead tracking and conversion tracking

Creative testing

Ad copywriting

Campaign auditing

Retargeting campaigns

GoHighLevel

CRM systems

Automated
 and SMS follow-up

Marketing workflows and pipelines

Google Ads is a major plus

Graphic design or video editing experience is a plus

Who We Are Looking For



The right person will be:



Highly experienced and confident inside Meta Ads Manager

Able to analyze data and make strategic decisions

Focused on generating qualified leads, not just cheap leads

Comfortable taking ownership of projects

Organized and good with systems

Able to identify problems without being micromanaged

Proactive about recommending new ideas

Reliable and consistent

Available during agreed-upon working hours

Able to communicate clearly in written and spoken English

Comfortable joining video calls and explaining marketing performance

Interested in building a long-term relationship with our company

Application Requirements



To be considered, you must submit a Loom video introducing yourself.



In your Loom video, please answer the following:



Tell us about yourself and your marketing experience.

Why do you believe you would be a good fit for this position?

What experience do you have running Meta ads?

Have you worked with roofing, remodeling, construction, or other home service businesses?

What type of monthly advertising budgets have you managed?

What were some of your best campaign results?

How do you evaluate lead quality?

What is your process when auditing an existing advertising account?

What experience do you have with GoHighLevel or other CRM systems?

What would you review first when taking over an account that has already spent hundreds of thousands of dollars?



Please also include:



Your resume

Your Loom video link

Examples or case studies from previous campaigns

Screenshots of results when available

The industries you have worked in

Your desired hourly or monthly rate

The number of hours you are available each week

Your internet speed

Your computer specifications

Your earliest available start date



Please do not send confidential information from previous clients. You may remove or blur names and other sensitive information.



Working Hours



This position will begin part-time.



We are open to discussing the schedule based on your experience and availability. There is a strong opportunity for this position to become full-time as you learn the company and begin producing results.



Some availability during United States Central Time business hours will be required for meetings and communication.



Compensation



Compensation will be based on experience, skill level, availability, and previous results.



We are willing to pay well for someone who has high-level marketing experience and can help us consistently generate qualified leads.



There may also be opportunities for increased compensation, additional hours, and performance-based bonuses as the role grows.



Important



This is not a basic virtual assistant position.



We are looking for someone who understands marketing strategy, paid advertising, lead generation, tracking, CRM systems, follow-up, and campaign optimization.



You should be able to review an established marketing operation, give us your professional opinion, and help take ownership of improving it.



Applications without a Loom video will not be considered.

title: Meta Ads Creative & Performance Lead
description:
Meta Creative & Performance Lead



We are looking for a hands-on Meta Creative & Performance Lead to own the full paid advertising cycle across a portfolio of e-commerce and service brands.



This is not a media-buying-only role. You will be responsible for d
 what ads should be created, producing those ads, launching campaigns and using performance data to determine what gets created next.



Core Responsibilities

Research & Strategy

Research customers, competitors, products and market trends.

Review account performance to identify opportunities.

Develop creative angles, hooks, offers and testing plans.

D
 what creative needs to be produced each week.

Creative Production

Design high-quality direct-response static ads.

Edit short-form video ads from existing footage.

Write hooks, on-screen text, primary copy and headlines.

Turn product images, UGC, testimonials and founder content into effective ads.

Produce new variations of winning concepts quickly.

Maintain each client’s brand standards.

Meta Ads Management

Build, launch and manage Meta campaigns.

Monitor budgets, audiences, tracking and performance.

Scale winning campaigns and reduce inefficient spending.

Identify creative fatigue and replace weak ads quickly.

Manage both e-commerce and lead-generation accounts.

Analysis & Reporting

Analyse performance at account, campaign and creative level.

Explain what is working, what is not and why.

Turn weekly insights into clear actions and new creative.

Identify offer, landing page or conversion issues outside the ad account.

Required Skills

Strong experience managing Meta Ads.

Strong understanding of direct-response advertising.

Graphic design skills using Canva or Adobe.

Short-form video editing using CapCut, Premiere Pro or similar.

Experience writing ad copy, hooks and headlines.

Strong commercial and analytical thinking.

Excellent organisation and attention to detail.

Confident written and spoken English.

Able to work independently and take ownership of results.



Experience with e-commerce brands, particularly fashion, health or supplements, is highly preferred.



What Success Looks Like

Every client receives new creative each week.

Creative is produced and launched without constant direction.

Winning concepts are identified and expanded quickly.

Underperforming creative is addressed before it damages results.

Reporting always leads to a clear action.

Meta revenue grows profitably across the portfolio.

The complete creative and campaign workflow runs consistently.

Tools



Experience with the following is preferred:



Meta Ads Manager

Canva and/or Adobe Creative Suite

CapCut and/or Premiere Pro

Shopify

Notion

Google Workspace

title: Short-Form Video Editor — Paid Social / UGC Ads (Full-Time)
description:
We're a US-based DTC brand hiring a full-time short-form video editor to produce paid social ads (Meta/TikTok-style, 9:16 vertical) from UGC raw footage. We're looking for an editor with strong creative instincts who can take raw creator footage and turn it into scroll-stopping ads using their own judgment — this is a role for someone with real short-form taste, not just technical execution.

What you'll do:



Edit 15s / 30s / 40s vertical ads from creator-supplied raw footage

Make your own creative calls on hooks, pacing, cuts, captions, SFX, and CTA — you d
 what makes the ad land

Bring a strong instinct for what stops the scroll in the first 2 seconds

Deliver a consistent daily output (roughly 5–6 short edits/day once ramped)



You must have:



Strong short-form/paid-social editing experience with a portfolio that shows real creative judgment (not just clean cuts)

A sharp instinct for hooks, pacing, and retention in vertical video

Fluency in Premiere Pro and/or CapCut; After Effects a plus

Excellent written English and reliable full-time availability

The confidence to work independently and make good decisions without hand-holding



Nice to have: experience editing DTC/ecommerce ads, Meta Ads familiarity, motion graphics.

To apply: Start your reply with the word "HOOK" so I know you read this. Include 2–3 links to vertical short-form ads you personally edited — pick the ones where you made the creative decisions, and tell me in one line why each hook works. Applications without samples or the code word won't be reviewed.

title: Remote On-Call Scheduler (U.S. Home Care)
description:
Comfort Keepers, a leading home care agency in New Hampshire, USA, is seeking a dependable and highly organized Remote On-Call Scheduler to support our clients and caregivers during evenings, nights, and weekends.



In this role, you will be responsible for responding to caregiver call-outs, client requests, schedule changes, and other after-hours staffing needs to ensure uninterrupted care for our clients. You'll work independently to resolve scheduling challenges, communicate professionally with caregivers and clients, and document all after-hours activity.



This is an on-call position, meaning work is performed only when calls, texts, or scheduling issues arise. There may be periods during your shift with little or no activity, but you must remain available to respond promptly when needed.



Schedule:

Every other week (7-day rotation)

Begins Monday at 5:00 PM Eastern Time (U.S.)

Ends the following Monday at 8:00 AM Eastern Time

On-call coverage includes:

Weekdays: 5:00 PM – 8:00 AM (next business day)

Weekends: Friday 5:00 PM – Monday 8:00 AM



While you will work independently during your assigned on-call hours, you are never alone. The Owner and administrative leadership team are available to provide guidance and support whenever needed.



We're Looking For Someone Who:

Has excellent spoken and written English.

Is calm under pressure and enjoys solving problems.

Has strong customer service and communication skills.

Can make sound decisions while working independently.

Has reliable high-speed internet and a quiet workspace.

Has experience with scheduling, customer service, healthcare, or home care (preferred).

title: Business Operations & Growth Manager
description:
Business Operations & Growth Manager (Part-Time)

Remote | Independent contractor | 20 hours per week | $800/month (approximately £600) + discretionary six-monthly performance bonus + opportunity for future rate progression



Help us build the future of compassionate leadership in healthcare.



Nurse Wellbeing Mission works with NHS organisations and healthcare leaders to create cultures where compassion becomes part of everyday practice, and healthcare workers thrive.



Our flagship programme, Empatheum, supports nurse and midwife leaders to develop more reflective, connected and compassionate cultures with their colleagues and patients. 



This is a rare opportunity to join a growing, mission-driven business at an exciting stage of its journey. You'll have the opportunity to shape systems, influence how we work, contribute ideas and see the direct impact of your work.



If you're someone who enjoys variety, autonomy and helping build something that makes a genuine difference to healthcare, we think you'll love this role.



About the role

Nurse Wellbeing Mission is a UK business led by Dr Nathan Illman (Clinical Psychologist) and he works alongside a small team of nurses and another psychologist. We provide coaching, consultation and training to health and care organisations. 

You'll work closely with Nathan, helping turn ideas into reality whilst also taking ownership of projects yourself. Nathan is a supportive founder who takes care of his team, caring about them as human beings and not just “workers”.



Our direction for 2026

In 2026 we are focusing on marketing and running our Empatheum programme - a 12 month development programme for nurses that helps them learn skills to support the wellbeing of their colleagues. With funding and future demand now in place for this programme, our aim is to scale it to reach a wider national, then international audience.



We are looking for an Operations and Growth Manager to join us and help us on our next step of the business journey. This role combines business operations and creating growth.



Approximately 60% of your time will be spent ensuring our programmes and business operations run smoothly.

Approximately 40% of your time will be focused on helping us improve, grow and identify new opportunities for partnerships with our programmes.



This isn't a role where you'll simply be given a list of tasks every day. Instead, we're looking for someone who enjoys taking ownership, improving systems and helping move the business forward.



We'll work together to agree on a number of success milestones for the role, and there will be the opportunity to receive a discretionary performance bonus each 6 months based on your contribution to the growth and development of the business.



Above all else, we're looking for someone who naturally asks:

"How could we make this better? rather than "What would you like me to do next?"



Hours & working arrangements

This remote role will be for 20 hours per week, with some flexibility in how this is spread across the week 

Availability is required for the UK time zone. This doesn’t necessarily mean the whole UK working day, but definitely the morning and up to around 1pm. 



You will have a weekly meeting, training and support with Nathan. Additional meetings and training will be provided during onboarding. Nathan aims to be approachable, supportive and available to help his co-workers be their best.



Contract type

This is a self-employed subcontractor role. The successful candidate will invoice Nurse Wellbeing Mission monthly for their agreed hours and will be responsible for managing their own taxes and any legal obligations in their country of residence.



This role will probably suit you if...

You enjoy figuring things out.

You notice opportunities that other people miss.

You enjoy organising complex projects and making them run smoothly.

You like improving systems rather than simply following them.

You like getting stuck into the data, numbers and feedback that can help improve a service.

You're comfortable using AI as part of your everyday work.

You enjoy taking ownership and initiative.

You communicate confidently and professionally.

You like working with a high degree of autonomy.



This role probably isn't for you if...

You prefer detailed instructions before getting started.

You enjoy administration but not improving systems.

You’ve got a great eye for design, but little interest or skill with numbers.

You'd rather execute ideas than help generate them.

You find ambiguity uncomfortable.

You're not interested in using AI to improve the way you work.



What you'll be responsible for:

OPERATIONS

The operations side of this role will primarily involve the timely and effective management and running of our Empatheum programme. 



The programme operates in a similar way to a traditional membership, though we work with organisational (B2B) clients, bringing them on board for 3 different launch windows per year. Following each launch, hundreds of participants embark on our 6 and 12 month programe which provides a range of support and training sessions to help improve the functioning and effectiveness of healthcare teams.



Below is a summary list of the kinds of tasks that are involved in the running and management of the programme: 



-Managing participant onboarding and enrolment, and developing and improving systems to monitor and enhance engagement, and liaise with the partner organisations.

-Maintaining our LearnWorlds (LMS) platform, including the internal pages of the programme and on-demand courses that form part of Empatheum.

-Supporting programme launches.

-Monitoring participant engagement and identifying people who may benefit from additional support.

-Developing further robust systems for collecting participant data and feedback to help promote the programme.

-Managing our business systems and administration.

-Coordinating bookings and programme logistics for our coaching and workshops.

Improving operational systems as the business grows.



GROWTH

Every week you'll have protected time dedicated to helping the business grow. Once you have first got your head around the business, our systems and the Empatheum programme, we’ll be guiding and empowering you towards spending time on business growth related activities such as:



-Following up warm leads.

-Leveraging our other existing network, clients and relationships.

-Building relationships with decision makers in NHS organisations.

-Supporting LinkedIn outreach.

-Researching opportunities, for example using AI and traditional Google search.

-Improving customer journeys.

-Identifying opportunities we haven't yet spotted.

-Bringing ideas to our weekly meetings.



How we'll measure success together

Rather than measuring success by simply counting completed tasks, we'll regularly review how you're helping the business become stronger, more organised and better able to grow.



Examples of success in this role might include:



Operations

-Empatheum cohorts launch smoothly and participants receive an excellent experience.

-Participant engagement is actively monitored, with clear visibility of who is attending, who may need support and which organisations are engaging well.

-Operational issues are identified and resolved before they become problems.

-Systems become more organised, documented and efficient over time.

-Nathan spends less time coordinating day-to-day operational details because you've taken ownership.

Growth

-Warm leads are consistently followed up.

-Contracts with existing customers are renewed, and expanded

-Meaningful conversations are being initiated with prospective organisations.

-AI is being used effectively to improve efficiency and generate new ideas.

-New opportunities are researched and brought forward proactively.

-Customer journeys and business systems are continually improving.

-Practical ideas are regularly brought to our meetings and turned into action.



Initiative & Ownership

This is probably the most important aspect of the role. Success doesn't mean waiting to be asked what to do next. Success means regularly saying things like:

"I've noticed something that we could improve."

"I've been thinking about how we could make this process easier."

"I've put together a draft system for us to look at."

"I spotted this pattern in our participant engagement."

"I think this could become a growth opportunity."



We don't expect every idea to be implemented. What matters is that you're naturally curious, proactive and continuously looking for ways to make the business better.



Performance Reviews & Bonus

We'll have regular informal check-ins throughout your time working with us, alongside a more structured review every six months.



During these reviews we'll reflect on your contribution to the business, discuss your development, agree new priorities and review your success milestones.



There will also be the opportunity to receive a discretionary performance bonus in recognition of exceptional contribution to the growth, systems and long-term development of Nurse Wellbeing Mission.



Experience, Skills & Mindset

We believe people can grow into roles, and we're much more interested in finding someone with the right mindset than someone who ticks every box. 



We don’t need you to have had tons of experience in our specific sector, though some experience of working in healthcare, and/or a B2B setting is definitely helpful.



Because this role will involves a high level of autonomy, we're looking for someone who already has experience of taking ownership, improving systems and helping a business run effectively.



We'd love to hear from you if you can demonstrate experience of:

-Working remotely with a high degree of autonomy.

-Managing multiple projects or priorities at the same time.

-Identifying opportunities to improve systems or processes, rather than simply following existing ones.

-Working closely with a founder, senior manager or leadership team.

-Communicating professionally with customers or clients.

-Using AI thoughtfully to improve the quality and efficiency of your work.



Software & Digital Skills

We're not expecting someone who already knows every platform we use. We'll support you to learn new systems where needed.



However, you should already feel confident using technology and be comfortable learning new software independently.

Ideally, you'll have experience with many of the following:



-Professional
 communication and document creation (without relying on AI to do the writing for you).

-Microsoft Excel and/or Google Sheets, including organising, analysing and presenting data.

-Project management software (such as Trello, Asana, ClickUp, 
 or similar).

-Canva or similar design software.

-AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude or Gemini.

-CRM,
 marketing or customer management software.

-Learning Management Systems (experience with LearnWorlds or similar would be an advantage, but is not essential).



Above all, we're looking for someone who enjoys learning new systems and quickly becomes confident using them.



Our Recruitment Process

We know applying for jobs takes time and energy, and we genuinely appreciate every application we receive.

Rather than relying solely on a traditional interview, we've designed a recruitment process that allows us to get to know how people naturally think, solve problems and communicate. 



Our recruitment process looks like this:



Stage 1 – Application

Please send us:



Your CV

A short covering letter (no more than one page) explaining why you're interested in this role and why you think you'd be a good fit. Please also tell us about one system, process or way of working that you've improved in a previous role. What did you notice, what did you change, and what difference did it make?



We value authenticity. Please write your cover letter yourself rather than relying on AI to generate it. We don't expect it to be perfect. We are much more interested in hearing your own voice.



We'll then take approximately 1-2 weeks to review all applications and invite a small number of candidates to progress to the next stage.



Stage 2 – Short Introduction Video

If you're shortlisted, we'll ask you to record a short (1–2 minute) video introducing yourself and telling us a little about why this role interests you.



You don’t need any fancy editing. Just show us an authentic snap shot of who you are. We find this a much better way to get a sense of someone's communication style and personality than reading a CV alone.



We will give you clear instructions on where to send this video, if you are successful in the first stage.



Stage 3 – Practical Skills Assessment

Candidates who progress to the next stage will be invited to complete a practical assessment. This involves recording a Loom (or similar desktop recording) of yourself completing a series of real-world business tasks that reflect the kinds of work you'd be doing in the role. 



The mock tasks will range from responding to an
, doing a short market research exercise, to solving a problem involving some basic data.



For this task, we are interested in both the output of what you do, but also how you go about it, including how you think through the problem. Throughout the assessment, we'll ask you to explain your reasoning as you work through each task.



The assessment takes approximately 45 minutes to complete.



If you are selected for this stage we will make further contact and provide detailed instructions to support you in participating.





Stage 4 – Interview

Following Stage 3 above, we'll invite a small handful of candidates to meet with Nathan, our Founder, for a relaxed interview.



By this stage we'll already have a good understanding of your experience and skills, so the interview is less about testing you and more about getting to know each other. 



We'll explore how you like to work, answer any questions you have, and d
 together whether the role feels like a good fit. 



Stage 5 – Reference Conversation

As one of the final stages of our recruitment process, we'll ask for the contact details of a previous manager or someone who has directly supervised your work.



Rather than requesting a standard written reference, we'd much prefer to have a short telephone or video conversation with them.



This gives us the opportunity to better understand your strengths, how you like to work, and the kinds of environments in which you thrive.



We'll always ask for your permission before contacting anyone.



Stage 6 – Paid Trial

Our preferred candidate will then be invited to complete a 2 week paid trial period. We believe this is the best way for both of us to experience what it's would be like to work together before making a longer-term commitment.



Timeframe and Applying for the role

Thank you in advance for taking the time to read this job application. We hope to invite prospective applicants for the practical task stage on week commencing 27th August, with interviews potentially occurring later that week and finalising the position on week of 3rd August.



Please contact us through 
 only for this role. We look forward to hearing from you. 



Regards,



Dr Nathan Illman, Director, Nurse Wellbeing Mission

title: Private On-Call Personal Assistant / Virtual Assistant (Flexible Hours)
description:
A fast-moving executive who travels often is personally hiring an On-Call PA. This is a one-to-one role with an individual, not a company, department, or corporate team. The work is personal, fast, and sometimes random. One minute you may be researching a trip, the next you may be calling a vendor, solving a problem, or helping turn a stressful day around.



If you want a quiet, traditional Executive Assistant job with the same routine every day, this is not for you.



No degree or past experience is required. Personality, good judgment, confidence, and the ability to learn matter most.



This can be a great fit for anyone with alignment. It will also work for the right student, who wants flexible, well-paid work built around their class schedule.



HOW IT WORKS



During agreed blocks of time, you will stay connected through a private video stream. The person you support is usually in back-to-back meetings and will remain connected and communicate through chat. You will stay on camera, check in often, and be ready when something comes up.



When nothing is needed, you may study, create, relax, or continue with your own activities while staying connected.



Separate calls will be held for planning and check-ins as needed.



THIS ROLE INCLUDES



# Helping with work, life, travel, ideas, and whatever comes up.

# Researching personal and business topics.

# Making calls, sending
s, meeting with vendors, and completing tasks.

# Handling quick changes, unusual requests, and last-minute needs.



YOU MAY BE A GREAT FIT IF YOU ARE



# Fluent in English and very outgoing.

# Naturally funny, social, and good at keeping the day interesting.

# Comfortable spending long periods on camera.

# Quick to respond and good at figuring things out.

# Comfortable with technology and willing to learn.

# Experienced in streaming, content creation, online communities, or personal support.



HOURS AND AVAILABILITY



Core hours can be planned around school or other fixed needs. Requests may also come at night, on weekends, or during holidays.



PRIVACY



You will have access to the private life and personal matters of a high-profile person. You may share your job title, but nothing else about the role may be shared with family, friends, clients, followers, or anyone else. You must sign an NDA and pass a full background check before starting.



PAY



You will track your billable hours each week and be paid promptly through the platform monthly. You will provide your own computer, phone, internet access, and handle your own taxes, insurance, and benefits.



HOW TO APPLY



In your response, you must include:



# Why you are the best fit for this role.

# Link to 1 to 3 photos of yourself that show off your personality.

# Answer how many hours you can provide each week.

# Provide the days and times you are available.

title: Executive Operations, Administrative Systems & Accountability Assistant
description:
About the Role

I am a therapist and entrepreneur looking for a highly organized, proactive, dependable, and fast-learning Executive Operations, Administrative Systems & Accountability Assistant.



I manage multiple professional, administrative, business, and personal responsibilities at the same time. I need someone who can help me take scattered information, unfinished tasks, deadlines, documents,
s, voice notes, and ideas and turn them into clear systems and completed action steps.



The immediate priority will be helping me work through a backlog of professional and administrative responsibilities. This will include gathering information from different sources, organizing supporting records, helping me complete required recurring professional documentation and reports, identifying missing information, organizing deadlines, and developing systems that make my ongoing workflow easier to manage.



The person hired does not need to already understand my specific professional forms or reporting requirements. However, they must be able to learn quickly, follow detailed instructions, organize information accurately, ask appropriate questions, and help me complete time-sensitive administrative responsibilities.



This is not only a temporary backlog position. Once the immediate priorities are under better control, the assistant will continue supporting me with executive assistance, scheduling, research, organization, follow-up, contractor coordination, professional correspondence, task management, workflow improvement, and other administrative responsibilities.



This is not a basic virtual-assistant position where you wait for instructions all day. I need someone who can listen carefully, identify next steps, create practical systems, follow up consistently, and help make sure important responsibilities do not get forgotten.



Experience working in a professional office, medical office, mental-health practice, clinical setting, healthcare environment, or another organized administrative setting is strongly preferred.



Immediate Priorities

During the first phase of this position, the assistant will help with responsibilities such as:



* Organizing a backlog of outstanding professional and administrative work

* Gathering information from calendars,
s, records, documents, notes, and other sources

* Helping organize the information needed to complete recurring professional forms, reports, and administrative requirements

* Assisting me while I complete required professional documentation

* Reviewing available information to identify missing dates, records, details, signatures, or supporting documents

* Organizing information by the appropriate reporting period, deadline, category, or requirement

* Creating a clear system to track what has been completed, what is incomplete, what is missing, what is waiting for review, and what needs follow-up

* Organizing supporting documentation that may eventually be needed for professional review or submission

* Helping prioritize overdue responsibilities so the most urgent and important work is completed first

* Establishing reminders and recurring review processes so future documentation is completed on time

* Organizing professional files into clear folders and categories

* Creating workflows that reduce the likelihood of falling behind again

* Maintaining confidentiality when working with sensitive professional information



The assistant will not independently make clinical decisions, provide clinical services, or complete professional documentation without my involvement. The assistant’s role is to help gather, organize, prepare, review, and track the information so that I can complete required professional responsibilities accurately and on time.



Ongoing Executive and Operations Responsibilities

The assistant will also help with responsibilities such as:



* Organizing daily, weekly, and monthly priorities

* Creating clear task lists from voice notes, messages, meetings,
s, and ideas

* Helping determine which responsibilities need to be completed first

* Breaking large or complicated assignments into manageable action steps

* Following up with me regarding deadlines, commitments, and unfinished tasks

* Following up with contractors or tea
mbers regarding assigned work

* Maintaining project-management systems, calendars, documents, trackers, and task lists

* Scheduling appointments, meetings, deadlines, reminders, and follow-up dates

* Researching professional requirements, opportunities, programs, services, tools, products, and other requested topics

* Organizing Google Drive folders, documents, passwords, files, and important information

* Drafting professional
s, messages, follow-ups, and basic documents

* Tracking applications, contracts, invoices, subscriptions, renewals, and important deadlines

* Coordinating with contractors and confirming whether assigned work has been completed

* Creating standard operating procedures, checklists, templates, and written instructions

* Documenting repeated processes so they can be completed more efficiently

* Providing accountability without being passive, overly agreeable, or afraid to respectfully speak up

* Identifying missing information, possible problems, overlooked tasks, and approaching deadlines

* Assisting with additional executive, professional, business, and personal administrative responsibilities as needed



Systems and Workflow Development

A major part of this role will be creating systems that make my work easier and more efficient.



The assistant must be able to:

* Review a disorganized or inefficient process and identify what is not working

* Create simple and practical workflows that are easy to maintain

* Develop trackers, checklists, templates, forms, recurring tasks, and reminder systems

* Organize information so it can be found quickly

* Reduce repeated work and unnecessary steps

* Create clear categories for tasks, documents, deadlines, and responsibilities

* Track what is overdue, incomplete, waiting, ready for review, completed, or missing information

* Create systems for recurring professional reports and administrative deadlines

* Document processes so they can be followed consistently

* Adjust or simplify a system when it is too complicated or is not working

* Recommend more efficient ways to manage repeated responsibilities



I do not need someone who creates complicated systems simply to make things appear organized. I need someone who creates realistic systems that save time, reduce stress, prevent missed responsibilities, and make workflows easier.



This Role Is a Good Fit for Someone Who:

* Is a fast learner

* Is naturally organized and enjoys creating structure

* Is skilled at creating systems that make workflows easier

* Can take disorganized information and turn it into a clear process

* Can quickly learn unfamiliar forms, requirements, and procedures

* Pays close attention to dates, numbers, details, deadlines, and missing information

* Has strong written and spoken English

* Can understand detailed instructions and turn them into manageable steps

* Can gather information from several different sources without losing important details

* Can handle multiple documents, deadlines, and responsibilities at the same time

* Is comfortable reminding a business owner about commitments and deadlines

* Can respectfully speak up when priorities are unclear or a plan is unrealistic

* Has good judgment and does not need every small decision explained

* Takes ownership of assigned responsibilities and follows through

* Communicates quickly when something is unclear, delayed, or cannot be completed

* Can work independently while still providing regular progress updates

* Is comfortable handling confidential and sensitive information

* Understands that accuracy is more important than simply marking a task complete

* Reviews work carefully before presenting it for approval

* Can distinguish between urgent, important, and lower-priority tasks

* Can work through a large backlog without becoming disorganized

* Is willing to ask questions rather than make unsupported assumptions



Preferred Professional Background

Preference will be given to applicants who have worked in one or more of the following environments:



* Professional office

* Medical office

* Mental-health or counseling practice

* Clinical or healthcare setting

* Administrative department

* Credentialing or compliance department

* Records-management position

* Legal or documentation-heavy office

* Executive office

* Small business or entrepreneurial environment



Clinical experience is not required. However, experience in a clinical or professional office is preferred because this role requires confidentiality, professionalism, accuracy, records organization, deadline management, and careful handling of detailed information.



Experience helping complete recurring reports, compliance documents, credentialing forms, professional records, or other detailed administrative paperwork is a strong advantage.



Required Skills and Experience

Applicants should have experience with most of the following:

* Executive assistance, administrative support, or operations support

* Organizing professional records and detailed documentation

* Gathering information from multiple sources

* Helping complete forms, reports, or administrative documents

* Reviewing documents for missing or incomplete information

* Project management and task tracking

* Creating and improving workflows

* Developing trackers, checklists, templates, and standard operating procedures

* Calendar, appointment, and deadline management

* File and document organization

* Online research

* Professional
 communication

* Google Workspace, including Gmail, Google Docs, Google Sheets, Google Calendar, and Google Drive

* Microsoft Word and Excel

* ChatGPT or other AI tools

* Trello, ClickUp, Asana, Notion, or another project-management platform

* Supporting an entrepreneur, executive, therapist, healthcare professional, consultant, or small-business owner



You do not need to know every system or form I currently use. However, you must be able to learn quickly, follow instructions, research unfamiliar processes when directed, and become comfortable working independently.



Important Qualities

The right person will be:

* Proactive

* Dependable

* Honest

* Resourceful

* A fast learner

* Detail-oriented

* Systems-focused

* Organized

* Patient

* Direct but respectful

* Comfortable asking necessary questions

* Able to meet deadlines

* Able to maintain confidentiality

* Consistent even when tasks are repetitive

* Willing to take responsibility for mistakes and correct them

* Comfortable following up more than once when necessary

* Able to work through a backlog without losing track of details



Please do not apply if you regularly disappear during working hours, miss deadlines without communicating, submit incomplete work, copy and paste AI-generated work without reviewing it, or require constant reminders to complete assigned responsibilities.



Hours and Compensation

* The position will begin at approximately 10 hours per week

* During the first month of orientation, training, system development, and backlog organization, hours may increase to as many as 20 hours per week

* Additional hours during the first month will depend on the workload and must be approved

* After the first month, the position is expected to return to approximately 10 hours per week unless additional hours are approved

* Compensation will be no more than $5.00 USD per hour

* Applicants requesting more than $5.00 USD per hour will not be considered

* Payments will be made biweekly

* A trial period will be required

* This is intended to become a long-term position for the right person



Work Schedule

Some schedule flexibility is available, but the assistant must:

* Have reliable internet access

* Be available for scheduled meetings when required

* Provide consistent progress updates

* Respond within the agreed communication window

* Be able to overlap for a reasonable amount of time with Eastern Time in the United States

* Be available for additional orientation and backlog hours during the first month when approved

* Communicate in advance when unavailable or unable to meet a deadline



How to Apply

Begin your application with the words:



“I create order from chaos.”



Applications that do not begin with this phrase will not be considered.



Please answer all of the following questions:

1. Describe your experience working as an executive assistant, administrative assistant, office assistant, operations assistant, or in a similar role.

2. Have you worked in a medical office, mental-health practice, clinical setting, healthcare setting, professional office, or another documentation-heavy environment? Describe your role and responsibilities.

3. Have you helped gather information and supporting records needed to complete recurring reports, professional forms, compliance paperwork, credentialing documents, or other detailed administrative requirements? Please explain.

4. Describe a system, tracker, checklist, template, or workflow you created that made someone’s work easier or more efficient.

5. How would you organize a large backlog of unfinished administrative and professional work?

6. How would you gather and organize information from
s, calendars, documents, notes, and other sources so that required forms or reports could be completed accurately?

7. How would you track reporting periods, deadlines, missing information, supporting documents, follow-up needs, and items waiting for review?

8. Describe a time when you reviewed detailed information and identified something that was missing, inconsistent, or incorrect.

9. How would you handle receiving a 10-minute voice note containing several tasks, ideas, deadlines, and unrelated thoughts?

10. Describe a situation where you noticed that your employer had forgotten something, was falling behind, or was trying to manage too many priorities. What did you do?

11. How do you respectfully hold a business owner accountable when they have not completed something they said they would do?

12. Tell me about a time you had to quickly learn a new system, tool, form, process, or professional requirement.

13. How do you d
 whether a new system is actually useful rather than unnecessarily complicated?

14. Which responsibilities listed in this posting are you strongest in?

15. Which responsibility would be the most challenging for you?

16. What days and hours are you normally available?

17. Are you available for up to 20 hours per week during the first month when additional orientation or backlog hours are approved?

18. Are you willing to accept a rate of no more than $5.00 USD per hour?



Required Application Task

Imagine you are given the following situation:

A therapist and entrepreneur has several months of unfinished professional and administrative work. Information is spread across
s, calendars, documents, supervision records, voice notes, screenshots, and handwritten notes. She needs help gathering and organizing the correct information so that recurring professional forms and reports can be completed accurately. She also has appointments, contractors,
s, deadlines, research tasks, and other administrative responsibilities that need to be managed.



Explain:

* What you would do first

* How you would organize the backlog

* How you would gather the information needed for each reporting period

* How you would identify missing or inconsistent information

* How you would organize supporting records so the required forms could be completed accurately

* How you would separate overdue, incomplete, waiting, completed, and ready-for-review items

* How you would determine which responsibilities should be completed first

* How you would provide progress updates

* How you would follow up with the business owner and other tea
mbers

* What system you would create to make future reporting and administrative work easier to complete on time



Do not provide a generic or fully AI-generated response. I am looking for evidence of your actual judgment, attention to detail, organizational ability, communication style, follow-through, and ability to create useful systems.

We are looking for an Order Issue Manager to join our fashion dropshipping store. This is one of the most important roles in the backend team — you'll be responsible for identifying, fixing and preventing order-related issues, from wrong sizes to supplier errors. Triple-S Logistics runs last-mile, cold-chain grocery delivery operations in the United States (New York City and Philadelphia). Our Real-Time Performance & Compliance Monitoring (RTPCM) team is how we hold that standard every single day, and we're growing it.

Check cold-chain compliance (dry ice, gel packs, product condition), staging, scanning, and proof-of-delivery.

Record findings, counts, and photos/video in real time, following our audit SOP and checklist.

Write clear, accurate audit reports and flag or escalate issues (cold-chain failures, late trucks, routing errors).

Track on-time and compliance metrics and support root-cause follow-up.

What We're Looking For





Sharp attention to detail and strong observation skills.

Clear written and spoken English — you'll be on live calls with US-based teams.

Reliable high-speed internet, a computer, and a smartphone.

Comfortable on live video calls and following structured procedures.

Basic reporting skills (Google Sheets / Excel); experience in logistics, delivery, operations, QA, or data analysis is a plus.

Dependable, organized, and able to work independently during US Eastern Time hours.





What We Offer





$200/$225 per week, paid weekly.

Training on our audit procedures and tools.

A real, hands-on role on a team that directly protects the business.





How to Apply

title: Video Editor — DTC Supplement Brand US | High-Growth Opportunity
description:
We're a US supplement brand scaling fast on Meta. Real spend, real volume, real results — and we're just getting started. The brand is on a clear trajectory upward, and the next hires we bring on are the ones who'll grow with it.



We don't want average. We want the editor who watches a winning ad and immediately knows how it was built, what's holding it back, and how to make a better one. The editor who's already experimenting with every new AI tool the day it drops. The editor who treats every ad like it's their own brand's money on the line.

If that's you — keep reading.



What you'll do



You'll own video creative across our entire ad funnel. Every week you'll be producing short-form VSLs, UGC edits, and animated pieces that go straight to scale on Meta. You'll work side by side with our creative strategists and copywriters, turning briefs and competitor inspiration into ads that print.



This isn't a sit-back-and-execute role. We move fast, we test fast, and we expect you to bring ideas — not just hands.



What you'll be making



-Faceless short-form VSLs (2–5 minutes) — multiple formats, multiple angles. Strong hooks, layered b-roll, motion graphics, captions, tight pacing throughout. The kind of VSL that holds a cold viewer all the way to the CTA



-UGC ads — editing creator footage into scroll-stopping ads. Hook-first, fast cuts, native feel, captions that punch



-Pixar-style animated ads — fully animated explainer ads that bring mechanisms, ingredients, and stories to life. Character-driven, polished, on-brand



-Variants and iterations — every winning ad gets hook variants, intro swaps, and angle tests. Speed of iteration matters as much as the original concept



-Competitor-inspired creative — we study what's working in the market and build smarter, better versions. You'll be a key part of that process



-Aspect ratios done right — 9:16, 4:5, 1:1, 16:9





What you'll be working with



-The full modern AI video stack: Higgsfield, Kling, Heygen, Runway, Veo, ElevenLabs, Sora, Midjourney — and whatever new tool drops next week



-Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, After Effects, whatever tool fits your skill.



-A creative team that actually knows what it's doing — strategists, copywriters, and a media buyer who'll give you fast, useful feedback



What we're looking for



-Proven experience editing DR / performance video ads — ideally supplements, health, or another DTC vertical



-Strong short-form VSL chops — you understand retention, pacing, b-roll layering, and how to keep a viewer locked in for 2–5 minutes



-Solid UGC editing skills — hooks that land in the first 2 seconds, native feel, captions in sync



-3D/Pixar-style animation experience — through traditional pipelines, AI tools, or a hybrid workflow. Portfolio examples required



-Hands-on fluency with the AI video stack — Higgsfield, Kling, Heygen at minimum



-Premiere Pro and/or DaVinci Resolve mastery; After Effects a strong plus



-Strong instincts for sound design and music — a huge part of what makes an ad hit



-Fast turnaround — multiple finished ads + variants per week, not per month



-Fluent English (written and spoken)



-Reliable, communicative, organized — you follow briefs without being chased



Nice to have



-Supplement or health DR background



-Motion graphics / After Effects template library



-Voiceover direction experience (briefing AI voices or human VOs)



-Familiarity with Notion, 
, or similar review workflows



What we offer



-Competitive monthly salary — paid on time, every time



-100% remote — work from home, set up your space however you want



-A real seat at the table — your work directly drives the brand. You'll see your ads hit scale and know which ones are yours



-Long-term role with real growth — as we scale, the people who scale with us get more responsibility, more ownership, more upside



-Top-tier creative team — you'll be working with strategists, copywriters, and buyers who are sharp, and you'll level up fast



-All the tools you need — full access to the AI stack and software subscriptions



How to apply



Send us a message through the platform with:



-Your portfolio / reel — lead with VSL, UGC, and animated work. Supplement or DR ad examples first if you have them



-Your typical turnaround speed — how many finished ads + variants per week do you ship?



-The tools you use daily



-Your rate expectation and availability



Applications without a portfolio won't be reviewed.



Ready to build something big?



If you've read this far and you're thinking "this is the role I've been waiting for" — apply now. We're moving fast and we want to talk to the best people first. The right editor will know within a few weeks that this was the best move they ever made.

We're not looking for someone who needs a job. We're looking for someone who wants this one.

Apply now.

title: Video Editor — Short-Form & Long-Form Content (Part-Time)
description:
The Role



We're looking for a skilled video editor to turn our raw footage into content that grabs attention and holds it. The work is a mix of:



Short-form video (the bulk of the work): Instagram Reels, TikToks, and YouTube Shorts cut from travel footage, event coverage, and marketing content

Long-form video: A few longer YouTube videos, edited for pacing and retention



Content will be mostly travel-related, with some business/marketing videos mixed in.



What Great Editing Looks Like to Us



We're not looking for someone who just trims clips and adds music. We want an editor who understands retention editing:



Motion and zoom effects — punch-ins, smooth zooms, and movement that keeps the frame alive

On-screen text and graphics — captions, callouts, and visual elements that add interest and reinforce the message

Calls to action — text and graphics that drive follows, comments, and clicks at the right 
nts

Pacing — knowing when to cut, when to breathe, and how to hook viewers in the first 2–3 seconds

Sound design — music selection, sound effects, and audio levels that match the energy of the edit



Responsibilities



Edit 2–3 videos per week to start (mix of shorts and occasional long-form)

Cut short-form vertical videos (9:16) optimized for Reels, TikTok, and YouTube Shorts

Add captions/subtitles to all short-form content

Apply motion graphics, zooms, text overlays, and CTAs

Select music and sound effects appropriate to the content

Deliver in agreed formats and turnaround times

Take feedback and turn revisions around quickly



Requirements



Proven experience editing short-form vertical video (Reels/TikTok/Shorts)

Experience editing long-form YouTube content

Proficiency in professional editing software (Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, Final Cut, or CapCut Pro — tell us what you use)

Strong sense of pacing, hooks, and retention

Ability to add clean, readable text and motion graphics

Reliable internet capable of handling large video file transfers

Good written English and responsive communication





Nice to have:





Experience with travel or event content

Familiarity with trending audio and short-form formats

Basic thumbnail design skills





How to Apply



Begin your application with the word DRUMBEAT so we know you read this posting all the way through. Applications that don't start with it will not be considered.



Then include:





A short introduction — who you are and how long you've been editing

Links to 3–5 examples of your work — at least two must be short-form vertical videos (Reels/TikToks/Shorts), and at least one should be a long-form video. Links must work; broken links are an automatic pass.

Which editing software you use

Your typical turnaround time for a 30–60 second short

Your rate (per video or hourly — tell us how you prefer to price) and your availability





We review every application that follows these instructions. We're looking for someone to grow with — as our content output increases, so will the work.
