title: Virtual Assistant for UK Comedy Tour Business — £200/week, long-term
description:
Virtual Assistant — UK/Europe Comedy Touring Business (long-term, Tue–Sat)



I manage the touring business of a UK stand-up comedian who performs across the UK and Europe. We're hiring a full-time virtual assistant to run the day-to-day operations. You'd be joining a small, friendly team — you'll work directly with our operations manager, who will train you personally. Everything is documented in step-by-step guides, so you don't need to have done this work before. You need to be smart, careful, and honest when something goes wrong.



Seven things about the job:



- You keep ticket sales moving. Every morning an automated report lands in
 showing how every show is selling. You work through it: shows selling slowly get attention, sold-out shows get closed on our ticketing platforms, and everything gets logged. Our platforms are TicketTailor, Eventbrite and Fienta — we'll teach you all three.



- You fix
 and Instagram ads by hand, following exact instructions. Our system detects problems with ads (wrong link, wrong settings, wasting money) and creates a task telling you precisely what to change in Meta Ads Manager. You follow the steps exactly — no ads experience needed, but great attention to detail is essential.



- You keep our tracking spreadsheet accurate.Venue fees, flights, accommodation, show statuses — you enter costs and update statuses in Google Sheets as bookings happen. This sheet drives real automated decisions, so accuracy matters more here than speed.



- You book travel and deal with venues. Flights, hotels and venue correspondence for tour dates across Europe — booked early, confirmed in writing, logged in the sheet.



- You promote shows. Posting in local
 groups for each tour city, creating
 events, sending
 campaigns in Mailchimp, and making simple graphics in Canva.



- You communicate constantly, in writing.A short plan at the start of each workday, a short summary at the end of each day, and one 15-minute call per week. The rest is
 messages. In this job, telling us about a problem early is a strength — the people who've done best with us are the ones who say "this is going wrong" the same day, not after it's too late.



- You will also be covering any
s and emergencies (within your hours) for another business



- It's stable, long-term work for a real business. Consistent weekly pay, paid on time every week, 13th month pay in December, and a manager who answers your questions. We're hiring for years, not months.



Pay and hours:



- £200 per week (about 64,000–66,000/month at current rates), paid weekly via Wise, on the same day every week.



- Tuesday to Saturday, 8 hours per day. Your day needs to overlap the UK morning, since that's when the daily report lands and the team is online. A window like 12PM to 9PM UK Time works well (that covers the UK morning through to early afternoon) — but we'll agree the exact hours together.



- 13th month pay (after more than six months with us), and Philippine regular holidays respected.



Requirements:



- Excellent written and spoken English — this is essential. Most of the job is reading instructions carefully and writing clear messages and
s.



- Careful, detail-oriented, and honest — you tell us when something is wrong or unclear, even when it's your own mistake. Especially then.



- Reliable internet and computer, with a backup plan for power or internet outages.



- Comfortable with Google Sheets, and willing to learn Meta Ads Manager, Mailchimp, Canva, ClickUp and our ticketing platforms — we train you on all of them.



- VA experience is NOT required. We care about how you think and communicate, not your CV.



How to apply:



Write a short application (a few sentences is fine — no essays) telling us: why this job suits you, one example of a time you spotted a problem and told someone about it early, and your internet/power situation including your backup plan. Applications that are clearly copy-pasted templates will not get a reply.



To show us you've read this far, put the word milkshake in the subject line of your application. Applications without it will not be read. Spend 7 apply points.

title: Senior Flutter / Dart Developer (Full-Time & Part-Time Considered)
description:
Remote · Full-time or part-time · Long-term role with an early-stage product team





ABOUT US

 

We're an early-stage startup building infrastructure for member-owned digital communities - trusted, validated online spaces that don't monetise their members' data or attention. Our first product is a private messaging service for a specific professional community, launching in the UK and expanding internationally.

 

We're a small, remote-first team. You'd be working directly with our CTO on a product where trust is the entire proposition — identity validation, private messaging, and a credentialed user base mean the technical bar is high and the work genuinely matters.

 

 

THE ROLE

 

You'll be a senior hands-on developer on our Flutter mobile app, building and shipping features across iOS and Android from a single codebase. You'll work inside an existing codebase that we're actively improving - so you'll spend as much time refactoring and levelling up what's there as you will writing new features.

 

You'll be responsible for the whole codebase, working closely with the CTO on the wider architecture and making solid technical decisions as you go. We're looking for someone senior enough to work independently, take a feature from spec to store, and be trusted with a security-sensitive codebase.

 

 

WHAT YOU'LL DO

 

- Build, test, and ship features on our Flutter app, targeting iOS and Android from one codebase

- Work within the existing codebase - maintain, refactor, and raise the quality of what's already there

- Own specific feature areas end-to-end (for example, real-time messaging, location/search, or push-notification flows)

- Integrate with our Python/Django backend over REST APIs for identity validation, registration, and messaging

- Work with secure storage and end-to-end encryption patterns, handling sensitive user data carefully

- Integrate third-party APIs and AI/LLM models (OpenAI, Anthropic, or similar) into the app

- Write tests, take part in code review, and follow our CI/CD and release processes

- Collaborate async with a UK-based team - clear written updates, well-described PRs, and good judgement about when to ask

 

 

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 

- 5+ years building production mobile apps, with at least 3 years shipping Flutter apps to the App Store and Google Play

- Strong Dart fundamentals and solid grasp of Flutter's rendering, state management, and platform channels

- Experience consuming REST APIs (a Python/Django backend is a plus)

- Firebase experience (push notifications, real-time features)

- Working knowledge of secure storage and end-to-end encryption patterns

- Comfortable inheriting and improving an existing codebase - auditing, refactoring, and raising standards without rewriting from scratch

- Solid testing, Git, and code-review discipline

- Excellent written English - this is a remote, async role and clear communication is essential

- Reliable, self-directed remote worker with a stable internet connection

 

 

NICE TO HAVE

 

- Mapbox or other location/mapping SDK experience

- Practical experience integrating AI/LLM models into production apps

- Native iOS (Swift) or Android (Kotlin) experience for occasional platform-code work

- Hands-on encryption / cryptography experience

- Experience integrating Yoti (or similar) identity verification

 

 

COMMUNICATION & AVAILABILITY REQUIREMENTS

 

- Fluent in English (written and spoken)

- Excellent communication skills

- Part-time candidates must be highly responsive to questions and messages

- Ability to clearly explain technical decisions and trade-offs

- Reliable, proactive, and professional

 



HOURS & TIMEZONE

 

This is a full-time role. While full-time availability is strongly preferred, we are also open to high-quality part-time developers who can commit to being highly responsive and communicative during agreed working hours. You'll need a reliable daily overlap with UK working hours (GMT/BST) for standups, code review, and collaboration - at least 4 hours of overlap with 9am–5pm UK time.

 



TO APPLY

 

Reply through onlinejobs.ph with:

 

- Your CV / résumé

- A link to a Flutter app you've shipped (App Store / Play Store link or repo)

- Your years of Flutter experience

- Your hourly and/or monthly rate

- Your availability during UK working hours (including typical response times)

- Whether you are applying for full-time or part-time work

- A couple of sentences on why you believe you are suitable for this role

 

Applications that do not include the above information may not be considered.

 

To show you've read this far, please start your application with the word SURFBOARD.

platform and we're looking for people we can grow from the ground up 

— not just workers, but the kind of people who take genuine pride in 

doing things right.

with high-value clients and holding yourself to a high standard on

the correct response on their own, using AI as a support tool rather 

than a substitute for judgment. Once you've proven you can

  informal communication (voice notes, 
s, Slack chaos included)

- Startup mindset — adaptable, steady, and not easily rattled

 with no context. One hasn't

Applications without the correct subject line, Ichigo Ichie

title: Software QA Tester
description:
We're looking for an experienced Software QA Tester to join our 

remote team and help us build proper systems from the ground up. 

This means testing our actual product — web app, mobile apps, and 

new features — for bugs before they reach real users. It's not a 

customer support or call-quality role. We're scaling a fintech 

platform and moving toward in-house development — we need someone 

who approaches quality the way a craftsman approaches their work. 

Thorough. Intentional. Proud of the output.



Nantoka Naru (??????) — things will work out, but only when

We train every tester to think critically about what could break

judgment about what's actually worth testing. Once you've shown you

We're a startup. The energy is young and direct. We don't need

- Coordinate with the development team on bug prioritization

- Escalate critical findings to your Lead immediately —

- Follow team rules, protocols, and procedures diligently at all times

- At least 1–2 years of hands-on QA or software testing experience

- Has written real test cases and test plans — not just ad-hoc clicking

- Confident — speaks up when something is wrong, even if inconvenient

- Understands hierarchy — knows when to d
 and when to escalate

- Easy to work with — culture fit matters as much as capability here

nt in

description:
Customer Service Agent — Logistics Company (Remote, Long-Term)

We're hiring a world-class customer service agent to be the front line for our clients. This is a long-term role for the right person — if you're fast, sharp, and take pride in flawless service, we want to talk to you.

The role



Long-term position, starting with a 1-week paid test period and evaluation, followed by a second evaluation after the first month. Do well and we're looking to keep you on board for the long run.

Schedule (36 hours/week, 6 days a week):



Weekdays: 7 hours per day, 7:00 AM – 2:00 PM Aruba time (AST, GMT-4). You pick one day off — Monday, Wednesday, or Thursday.

Saturday & Sunday: 4 hours, 8:00 AM – 12:00 PM Aruba time. Weekends are required.





Pay: $6–$10 USD/hour, based on experience and how you perform during the test week.



What you'll do



Answer client messages across WhatsApp,
, and chat quickly and accurately

Resolve questions about packages, shipping, pricing, and account issues

Keep responses clear, friendly, and professional

Escalate the right issues at the right time and follow up until they're closed

Pitch in on other tasks. When the inbox is clear and all clients are answered, you'll help out with other tasks — no "that's not my job" attitude here.

Make us better. This isn't just an inbox job. You'll help build out our knowledge base, flag patterns worth fixing, and proactively suggest ways to level up our customer service — from response templates to workflow improvements to ideas we haven't thought of yet.



What we're looking for



Fast and smart. You think on your feet, learn our systems quickly, and don't need to be told twice.

Exceptionally smart — and able to prove it. Cum Laude or Summa Cum Laude graduates are strongly preferred. But if you don't have the honors title and know you're still in the top tier, show us: top exam scores, a standout portfolio, an impressive project, a hard-won achievement — whatever demonstrates you're genuinely one of the sharpest people we'll talk to.

Strong English is essential. You need to write and speak English at a high level — clear and professional. Sounding natural is a big plus. Spanish is a plus too.

Excellent written communication — polished, warm, and error-free.



Required — strong, demonstrated AI fluency. This is core to the role. You already use AI daily and know how to make it work for customer service: drafting fast, accurate replies, translating between languages, summarizing long threads, and holding a consistent tone at scale. To confirm you've read this far, please begin your application with the words "I Love Logistics." You should move faster and deliver higher quality because of how you use AI, not in spite of it.

A paid AI assistant account (ChatGPT Plus, Claude Pro, or equivalent) is a plus. Not required, and not reimbursed at this time.



To apply

Send a short note on why you're a great fit, your proof of academic or intellectual excellence (honors, scores, portfolio, or a standout achievement), and answer this:



Walk us through exactly how you'd use AI to handle a busy customer inbox during a 7-hour shift — which tools, and what your workflow looks like fro
ssage in to reply out.



Bonus: Record a short video (2 minutes or less) telling us why you're a great fit and share the link. Not required, but it goes a long way — and it's the fastest way to stand out.

We're looking for someone who clearly does this already — vague or generic answers won't make the cut.



Hope to meet our awesome Customer Service agent soon.

title: Part-Time Growth Marketer for Med Spa

Compensation: Base Rate: $10.00+/hour, performance bonus possible



Note: There will be a 30–60 day probationary testing period at a lower rate to evaluate speed, technical execution, and communication.



About the Role



We are an established medical spa seeking a tech-forward, results-driven Remote Marketing Specialist to take full ownership of our local lead generation, search visibility, web presence, and technical social media distribution.



We are looking for an AI-proficient executor who utilizes modern automation and generative tools to move lightning-fast and integrate smoothly with our internal tech team. Your primary objective will be optimizing our digital ecosystem to maximize down-funnel conversions and drive high-ticket, booked consultations into our clinic.



Core Responsibilities



1. Paid Performance Advertising & Optimization



- Build, monitor, and optimize local lead-generation campaigns on Meta,
/Instagram, and Google Ads.

- Continuously test landing pages, ad hooks, headlines, and video creatives to hit strict Cost-Per-Lead (CPL) and Cost-Per-Booked-Appointment (CPBA) targets.



2. AI SEO (GEO) & Traditional Search Ranking



- Optimize our web infrastructure, structured schema data, and FAQ layers so our med spa is consistently cited and recommended by AI answer engines, including ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Google AI Overviews.

- Execute weekly optimization tasks for our Google Business Profile (GBP) to maintain a top position in local map packs.



3. Website Management & Automation Infrastructure



- Execute immediate text, layout, asset, and pricing updates on our website, WordPress/Elementor or GoHighLevel.

- Build high-converting, responsive landing pages for targeted seasonal promotions.

- Ensure flawless conversion tracking using Meta Pixel, Conversions API, and Google Tag Manager.

- Build and monitor automated data flows via Zapier to connect front-end leads instantly to our CRM.



4. Technical Social Media Management



- Take raw video footage/photos provided by our on-site team, edit them into high-converting, aesthetic Reels/TikToks, and schedule them.

- Manage the back-end engagement, monitoring incoming direct messages (DMs) to rapidly guide interested users to our calendar booking link.



Required Skills & Experience



- 2+ years of verifiable experience managing paid ads, website infrastructure, and SEO specifically for medical spas, aesthetic clinics, or high-ticket local service businesses.

- Deep technical command over WordPress/Elementor, Zapier, Meta Ads Manager, and Google Tag Manager.

- AI Tool Fluency: Highly proficient using AI tools such as ChatGPT, Midjourney, Claude, and video editors to accelerate content creation, programming logic, and copywriting workflows.

- Exceptional written and spoken business English with the ability to build data-driven performance reports.



Nice-to-Have Skills



- Experience related to commercial real estate or private equity work is a plus, but not required.



Reports To



Owner and Manager



How to Apply



To ensure you have attention to detail, applications that do not follow these steps will be automatically disqualified:



1. Reply to this job post with the exact subject line: GROWTH MARKETER

3. Include a link to a brief 30 to 60-second Loom or Google Drive video introducing yourself, outlining your technical background, and explaining how you utilize AI to speed up your daily marketing tasks.

You must already know how to take a warm homeowner lead, build immediate trust, ask smart qualifying questions, handle real objections, and set a high-quality appointment for a closer. We need someone who can step into a disciplined system and perform quickly with minimal handholding.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Call warm, opted-in homeowners during U.S. business hours, Monday through Friday

- Work inside our GoHighLevel power dialer and CRM using a proven process

- Run discovery, establish interest, qualify accurately, handle objections, and set appointments that show up ready for the closer

- Keep complete, clean notes, dispositions, and follow-up activity inside GoHighLevel

- Protect the customer experience and lead quality while maintaining reliable daily activity



EXPERIENCE REQUIRED

- At least 3 years of successful outbound appointment-setting, SDR, live-transfer, telemarketing, or phone-sales experience in U.S.-facing campaigns

- A track record of setting qualified appointments consistently—not merely making calls or taking inbound support tickets

- Strong experience with a CRM and power dialer; GoHighLevel experience is a major advantage

- Able to explain the campaigns you have worked, the audiences you called, your typical appointment volume, and how you protected appointment quality

- Clear, confident, easy-to-understand English; neutral or American accent strongly preferred

- Strong discovery, listening, objection-handling, and follow-up discipline

- Full-time availability aligned with U.S. business hours, 40 hours per week

- Reliable high-speed internet, professional headset, and quiet work environment



THIS IS NOT A BEGINNER ROLE

Do not apply if you need basic calling training, have never set qualified appointments, cannot work full-time U.S. business hours, or are looking only for part-time or administrative work. We provide the workflow, standards, and performance feedback; you bring the proven calling skill and professional judgment.



WHY PROSPER

- Warm, opted-in leads—no list building or random cold outreach

- Clear systems and accountability for people who already know how to perform

- A serious growth path for strong producers: Setter to Senior Setter, Closer, Coach, or Team Leader

- We care about lead quality and customer experience, not just activity volume



HOW TO APPLY

Send a short note that includes:

1. Your years of direct outbound appointment-setting experience

2. The U.S.-facing campaigns or industries you have worked

3. Your normal appointment-setting volume and one example of overcoming an objection to set a qualified appointment

4. The CRM and dialers you have used

5. Confirmation that you are available for 40 hours per week during U.S. business hours



Prosper hires carefully. We select based on demonstrated skill, relevant experience, ownership, and interview performance. A formal offer will be provided after the interview process.

title: Social Media Content Creator (Reels, Stories & Graphics) flexible hours
description:
About the Position

We're seeking a highly creative and detail-oriented Social Media Content Creator to produce premium, engaging content for a diverse portfolio of businesses.



You will transform written content, marketing concepts, and brand assets into compelling Reels, Stories, and graphics designed to capture attention, educate audiences, and increase engagement.



This role is ideal for a creative professional who is interested in growing alongside us. It will begin with a smaller workload, with the opportunity to expand into a consistent, long-term position as our business and client portfolio continue to grow. We value creativity, professionalism, reliability, and a commitment to producing high-quality work while continuously improving and evolving.



What You'll Create

You'll create a variety of branded social media content (Static Graphics, Stories, and Reels- Motion Graphic / Text-Based and 

Video Editing Reels)



What We Provide

Most projects include everything you'll need, such as:

Written content or creative direction

Brand colors and logo files

Brand guidelines (when available)

Design references

Project goals and target audience



Some projects will include detailed instructions, while others may only provide a concept or written description. In those cases, you'll be expected to create an original, professional design that aligns with the brand.



Design Expectations

We're looking for someone who creates polished, modern, and original content—not someone who relies on basic templates  or depend on AI to produce finished content 



You should be comfortable:

Designing layouts from scratch

Creating custom backgrounds

Sourcing professional stock images and B-roll

Using typography, icons, and graphics effectively

Maintaining consistent branding across all content

Proficiency with professional design and video editing software is required.



Key Responsibilities

Design high-quality social media graphics

Edit engaging short-form videos

Create motion graphics and animated text

Assemble content into ready-to-publish assets

Organize project files in Google Drive or Dropbox

Deliver projects on schedule

Maintain brand consistency

Communicate professionally throughout each project



To confirm you've read the entire job description, begin your application with: Royal Vision. Applications that do not follow these instructions will not be considered.



How to Apply

Please include:

Your portfolio

2–3 sentences explaining why you're a good fit for this role. Generic, copy-and-paste applications will not be considered.

The software you primarily use

Your typical turnaround time for both a Reel and a graphic post



Paid Test Project

Shortlisted applicants will complete a paid test project to evaluate:

Creativity

Design quality

Video editing skills

Attention to detail

Ability to follow creative direction

Overall content quality



Thank you for taking the time to review this opportunity. We look forward to seeing your creativity and learning more about your work.

title: Customer Support Experts Needed
description:
We are now hiring Customer Support Experts to assist our customers over the phone.

This is a full-time position only with long-term potential



Customers will call us and ask for assistance with various tasks, such as:



Checking their email accounts

Purchasing items they need

Signing up for services

Logging into or managing their accounts

Checking or signing up for credit score reports

Conducting general online searches



The tasks we handle are all things that can be done online.



PAY & EARNING STRUCTURE



Base rate starts at $4.50 per hour.

Agents usually work 10 hours per day including the paid breaks, and we allow more hours if someone wants to earn more.

During busy times, we also pay time-and-a-half overtime when we need additional coverage.

Good performers can earn a monthly bonus between $60 and $150.

There is a $50 monthly attendance bonus for consistent on-time performance.

Every 6 months, we evaluate performance and agents can receive up to an extra $0.50 per hour added to their rate if they are doing well.



With base hours plus bonuses and performance increases, a strong performer can earn up to around $1,100 per month.



This is the roadmap of our hiring process:



- You will take a quiz that typically takes about an hour to complete.

- If you pass the quiz, you will be invited to take two live mock calls or skill tests. The first one usually takes around 20 minutes, and the second one is longer, typically about an hour.

- Once you pass, you will then proceed with orientation and training.



Please note that our quizzes and skill tests can be challenging for beginners and require sharpness, speed and excellent attention to details. If you believe you possess these skills, feel free to apply.



You need to have fluent English as well as having very good internet connection and a quiet place to work.

Please apply only if you are fully available for a full-time position.

Please do not apply if you are not based in the Philippines.



When You Apply*



Please answer the following questions:



1. How many hours are you available daily, and on which days of the week?

2. How soon are you ready to start?



Lastly, please include a link to a Vocaroo audio recording (minimum 45 seconds) where you briefly introduce yourself. Tell us a bit about your background, relevant experience, and one hobby you genuinely enjoy. This is a voice account and you will be supporting customers, so it's essential that you send a high-quality voice recording.



Thanks,

Alfred

title: Credit repair va
description:
# Experienced Credit Repair Virtual Assistant (A–Z Specialist) — Remote



**Company:** T&E Simple Solutions LLC (Credit Repair & Restoration)

**Position:** Full-Time Virtual Assistant — Credit Repair Specialist

**Location:** Remote

**Compensation:** Based on experience (state your desired rate when applying)



---



## About the Role



We are a growing credit repair and business funding company looking for an experienced VA who knows credit repair **from A to Z** — not someone who just sends template letters. You will manage client files from intake through funding-readiness, running aggressive, strategic dispute sequences designed to position clients for personal funding approvals (credit cards and personal loans).



This is a results-driven role. You should be able to look at a credit report and immediately know the attack plan.



## What You'll Be Doing



- Analyze full 3-bureau credit reports (via SmartCredit) and build dispute priority strategies

- Run aggressive dispute rounds in **DisputeFox** using factual and Metro 2-based dispute methods (not generic templates)

- Sequence disputes strategically: collections, charge-offs, late payments, inquiries, personal information cleanup

- Pull, review, and dispute **ChexSystems** and **Early Warning Services (EWS)** consumer reports for clients with banking denials

- Set clients up on credit builder accounts (Self, Kikoff, CreditStrong, secured cards, tradelines) sequenced toward personal funding timelines

- Optimize client profiles for funding: utilization targets, primary accounts, credit mix, inquiry management

- Track deletions, score movement, and round progress; keep client files updated

- Conduct client onboarding Zoom calls: verify documents, enroll monitoring, set expectations, walk through the game plan

- Communicate with the team via **Slack** and manage pipelines/follow-ups in **GoHighLevel (GHL)**



## Required Experience



- 2+ years hands-on credit repair experience (agency or CRO background preferred)

- Proven knowledge of **FCRA, FDCPA, and Metro 2 compliance-based disputing**

- Working knowledge of **ChexSystems and EWS** dispute processes

- Proficient in **DisputeFox** and **SmartCredit** (or ability to prove fast mastery of similar tools — Credit Repair Cloud, IdentityIQ, etc.)

- Experience with **GoHighLevel** (pipelines, calendars, automations) and **Slack**

- Comfortable on camera for client-facing Zoom onboarding calls

- Fluent English (written and spoken)

- Understanding of what underwriters look for in personal funding approvals



## Bonus Points



- Experience with business credit / business funding prep

- Familiarity with LexisNexis, SageStream, Innovis (secondary bureau) disputes

- Sales or consultation call experience

- Available during US Eastern Time business hours



## How to Apply



To filter out mass applications, please include ALL of the following:



1. The word **"BLUEPRINT"** in the first line of your application

2. Your credit repair experience: how many client files you've managed and with which software

3. Walk us through (briefly) how you would sequence disputes for a client with 3 collections, 2 charge-offs, and high utilization who wants a personal loan in 6 months

4. Your experience level with ChexSystems/EWS disputes

5. Your desired hourly rate and availability (hours per week + timezone)



Applications missing any of these will not be considered.

title: Virtual Assistant for UK Comedy Tour Business — £200/week, long-term
description:
Virtual Assistant — UK/Europe Comedy Touring Business (long-term, Tue–Sat)



I manage the touring business of a UK stand-up comedian who performs across the UK and Europe. We're hiring a full-time virtual assistant to run the day-to-day operations. You'd be joining a small, friendly team — you'll work directly with our operations manager, who will train you personally. Everything is documented in step-by-step guides, so you don't need to have done this work before. You need to be smart, careful, and honest when something goes wrong.



Seven things about the job:



- You keep ticket sales moving. Every morning an automated report lands in
 showing how every show is selling. You work through it: shows selling slowly get attention, sold-out shows get closed on our ticketing platforms, and everything gets logged. Our platforms are TicketTailor, Eventbrite and Fienta — we'll teach you all three.



- You fix
 and Instagram ads by hand, following exact instructions. Our system detects problems with ads (wrong link, wrong settings, wasting money) and creates a task telling you precisely what to change in Meta Ads Manager. You follow the steps exactly — no ads experience needed, but great attention to detail is essential.



- You keep our tracking spreadsheet accurate.Venue fees, flights, accommodation, show statuses — you enter costs and update statuses in Google Sheets as bookings happen. This sheet drives real automated decisions, so accuracy matters more here than speed.



- You book travel and deal with venues. Flights, hotels and venue correspondence for tour dates across Europe — booked early, confirmed in writing, logged in the sheet.



- You promote shows. Posting in local
 groups for each tour city, creating
 events, sending
 campaigns in Mailchimp, and making simple graphics in Canva.



- You communicate constantly, in writing.A short plan at the start of each workday, a short summary at the end of each day, and one 15-minute call per week. The rest is
 messages. In this job, telling us about a problem early is a strength — the people who've done best with us are the ones who say "this is going wrong" the same day, not after it's too late.



- You will also be covering any
s and emergencies (within your hours) for another business



- It's stable, long-term work for a real business. Consistent weekly pay, paid on time every week, 13th month pay in December, and a manager who answers your questions. We're hiring for years, not months.



Pay and hours:



- £200 per week (about 64,000–66,000/month at current rates), paid weekly via Wise, on the same day every week.



- Tuesday to Saturday, 8 hours per day. Your day needs to overlap the UK morning, since that's when the daily report lands and the team is online. A window like 12PM to 9PM UK Time works well (that covers the UK morning through to early afternoon) — but we'll agree the exact hours together.



- 13th month pay (after more than six months with us), and Philippine regular holidays respected.



Requirements:



- Excellent written and spoken English — this is essential. Most of the job is reading instructions carefully and writing clear messages and
s.



- Careful, detail-oriented, and honest — you tell us when something is wrong or unclear, even when it's your own mistake. Especially then.



- Reliable internet and computer, with a backup plan for power or internet outages.



- Comfortable with Google Sheets, and willing to learn Meta Ads Manager, Mailchimp, Canva, ClickUp and our ticketing platforms — we train you on all of them.



- VA experience is NOT required. We care about how you think and communicate, not your CV.



How to apply:



Write a short application (a few sentences is fine — no essays) telling us: why this job suits you, one example of a time you spotted a problem and told someone about it early, and your internet/power situation including your backup plan. Applications that are clearly copy-pasted templates will not get a reply.



To show us you've read this far, put the word milkshake in the subject line of your application. Applications without it will not be read. Spend 7 apply points.

title: Long-Term YouTube Video Editor – AI, Automation and Business Content

1. Your Responsibilities:

You will be responsible for editing primarily long-form YouTube videos, with occasional short-form content.



Your work may include:

- Editing talking-head footage and screen recordings

- Creating clear motion graphics and visual explanations

- Illustrating workflows, systems, data flows and business processes

- Improving pacing and storytelling

- Cleaning and enhancing audio

- Adding appropriate music and sound design

- Creating professional YouTube thumbnails

- Repurposing selected content into Shorts when required



The videos will often be educational and technical. You should be able to make complicated topics easy to understand without making the editing feel childish or overly distracting.



2. What I’m Looking For

- Strong experience editing professional YouTube content

- Experience creating custom motion graphics for educational or business videos

- Good understanding of pacing, viewer retention and storytelling

- Strong attention to detail

- Experience editing screen recordings, software demonstrations or tutorials

- Good sound-design and audio-cleanup skills

- Experience creating thumbnails in Photoshop, Canva or similar tools

- No generic AI-generated thumbnails or low-effort AI visuals

- Reliable communication and the ability to meet agreed deadlines

- Willingness to receive feedback and improve over time



Experience with AI, automation, SaaS, technology or business content is helpful, but not required.



3. What You’ll Get

- A stable, long-term working relationship

- Consistent work

- Remote work with flexible hours

- Competitive compensation based on your skills and experience

- Clear feedback and communication

- Opportunities to take on more responsibility as the channel grows

- The chance to help shape the style of a new professional YouTube channel



The expected workload is approximately 1–2 long-form YouTube videos per week, typically between 8 and 15 minutes, depending on the complexity of the edit and motion graphics required. There may also be occasional Shorts and thumbnail creation.



The priority is quality rather than meeting a fixed video quota. Some videos will require relatively straightforward editing, while others may involve more extensive motion graphics, visual explanations and sound design.



This position is currently part-time, but with the potential to grow into a full time position quickly if both sides feel comfortable.

title: Dispatch + Lead generator
description:
We are a growing appliance repair company. We currently handle around 15–16 jobs per week on average (about 60 jobs per month) and are looking to scale up.

We need a proactive dispatcher.

Schedule & Time Zone:

•  We work in Central Time (CST).

•  Main working hours: 9 AM – 5 PM CST (Monday to Friday).

•  After hours (5 PM – 8 PM CST) is additional. If you want, you can stay after hours or choose an after-hours schedule when call volume rises.

Important information about the current workflow:

•  Call volume varies greatly: sometimes 2–5 calls per day, with long breaks during the day (especially lunch).

•  There can be slow days with few or even zero incoming calls.

•  On quiet periods you will handle follow-ups, monitor technician schedules, ensure they are on time, and other tasks.

Call details:

•  Average call duration is 2–5 minutes.

•  Clients mostly call to request a quote/offer for appliance repair.

•  You will also need to make outgoing calls for follow-ups, scheduling, and business development.

•  We have a backup outsourced call center. If two incoming calls happen at the same time (this almost never happens), the call will be redirected.

•  Important: You must answer calls within 3 rings.

Responsibilities:

•  Answer incoming calls, schedule repairs and dispatch technicians.

•  Make outgoing calls (follow-ups, confirmations, etc.).

•  Manage job calendar and workflow.

•  Key focus — Insurance partnerships:

 •  Research and contact insurance companies.

 •  Help sign contracts with insurance providers.

 •  Support B2B direction with property managers when needed.

 •  Help grow the total number of orders.

Compensation:

•  Fixed hourly rate: $2.00 per hour (paid only for actual hours worked).

•  Bonus system:

 •  $5 for every booked and scheduled job.

 •  Good bonuses for every signed contract with insurance companies and property managers / apartment complexes.

Bonus calculation example:

•  At current volume (~60 jobs per month): 60 × $5 = $300 from job bonuses.

•  If we double the volume (120 jobs per month): you will earn $600 from job bonuses.

We have all the tools and advertising ready to scale. With your help we can easily reach 100–120+ jobs per month, which means significantly higher earnings for you.

Total example — Monday to Friday, 9 AM to 5 PM (8 hours/day, ~22 working days/month = 176 hours):

•  Fixed rate: 176 × $2.00 = $352

•  At current 60 jobs: + $300 (job bonuses)

•  Total ? $652 (and much more as we grow with insurance contracts and higher job volume).

Requirements:

•  Perfect English communication skills (C1 level or higher).

•  Strong experience in customer service or sales.

•  Motivated and able to work independently.

•  Reliable internet connection.
